>
> ## Step 2 — OrchestrationPlanMachine (OrchestrationPlanMachine.cs)
>
> ### Internal state
>
> ```csharp
> // FlowIndex: ALL FLOW docs loaded at construction from private corpus path.
> // KnownFlowRetrieval (Mode 1) uses this; NOT part of trained ML weights.
> private readonly Dictionary<string, OrchestrationPlanChosen> _flowIndex;
>
> // PromptFlowIndex: normalized known-prompt text → FlowRef.
> // Second Mode 1 trigger — catches accepted prompts without explicit FLOW number.
> private readonly PromptFlowIndex _promptFlowIndex;
>
> // Mode 2 (generalization) trained state:
> private readonly OrchestrationKnnStore _knn = new();
> private readonly Dictionary<string, OrchestrationStructureWeights> _patternMap = new();
>
> // Mode 3 (human explanation) trained state:
> private readonly OrchestrationKnnStore _humanExplanationKnn = new();
> ```
>
> ### TrainBatchAsync
> - Skip `Mode1KnownFlowRetrieval` pairs — they are deterministic source-authority, not ML
> - For `Mode2Generalization` pairs: tokenize Prompt → update `_patternMap` weights; store in `_knn`
> - For `Mode3HumanExplanation` pairs: tokenize PromptText + AttachedFileNames → store in `_humanExplanationKnn`
>
> Mode 1 pairs contribute to `_flowIndex` deterministically (loaded at construction, not updated by training).
>
> ### EvaluateAsync — three-tier metrics
>
> **Tier 1 — KnownFlowRetrieval routing quality** (pairs where Mode=Mode1KnownFlowRetrieval):
> - Call `GeneratePlan(prompt)` → must route to FlowIndex via detector
> - Score: `retrievalHit = correct FlowRef found AND FlowIndex lookup succeeded`
> - Score: `exactStructureMatch = all 5 structural metrics pass`
> - `knownFlowRetrievalRouteAccuracy = fraction of Mode 1 pairs where retrievalHit AND exactStructureMatch`
> - ⚠ This is a ROUTING metric — it does NOT count toward `overallTrainingAccuracy`
>
> **Tier 2 — Mode 2 style accuracy** (pairs where Mode=Mode2Generalization):
> - Score: 5 FLOW-specific structural metrics
> - `taskTypeRecall` skipped when expected count = 0 (not counted in mean)
> - `phaseCountAccuracy` clamped to [0,1]
> - `unseenStyleAccuracy = mean productAccuracy across Mode 2 held-out pairs`
> - `overallTrainingAccuracy = unseenStyleAccuracy` (Mode 2 ONLY — not mixed with Tier 1)
>
> **Tier 3 — Mode 3 explanation accuracy** (pairs where Mode=Mode3HumanExplanation):
> - Score: 4 metrics: `problemStatementPresent`, `functionalityStepsCount >= 2`, `implementationPhasesCount >= 1`, `noMachineJargon`
> - `humanExplanationAccuracy = mean across Mode 3 test pairs`
>
> `PassesGate = knownFlowRetrievalRouteAccuracy >= RetrievalTarget AND unseenStyleAccuracy >= StyleTarget AND humanExplanationAccuracy >= ExplanationTarget`
>
> ### GeneratePlan(prompt) → string (three-mode dispatcher)
>
> ```csharp
> // Step 1: Pre-router — check for human explanation intent BEFORE FLOW detection
> // (a prompt with "33-system initiation.md объясни" is Mode 3, NOT Mode 1)
> var intent = HumanExplanationIntentDetector.Detect(prompt);
> if (intent is not null)
> {
>     // Mode 3: Human orchestration explanation — ML learned from grok corpus
>     var nearestExplanation = _humanExplanationKnn.FindNearest(prompt);
>     return RenderHumanExplanation(nearestExplanation, intent, prompt);
> }
>
> // Step 2: Detect FLOW reference via multi-pattern detector
> var flowRef = FlowReferenceDetector.Detect(prompt);
>
> // Step 3: If no explicit ref, check PromptFlowIndex (known accepted prompts)
> if (flowRef is null) _promptFlowIndex.TryGetFlow(prompt, out flowRef);
>
> // Mode 1: KnownFlowRetrieval — deterministic source-authority path
> if (flowRef is not null && _flowIndex.TryGetValue(flowRef, out var chosen))
>     return SerializeChosen(chosen);   // NOT ML — renders canonical file content
>
> // Mode 2: Generalization — KNN + PatternMap ML style plan
> var nearest = _knn.FindNearest(prompt);
> return ApplyPatternMapOverlay(nearest, _patternMap, prompt);
> ```
>
> ### GetOrchestratorAsync → OperationResult\<ILogicalOrchestrator\>
>
> ```csharp
> var trainedComposer = new TrainedRouteComposerUnit(this);         // three-mode dispatcher
> var pipeline = new TaskOrchestrationUnit(routeComposer: trainedComposer);
> var orchestrator = new OrchestrationPlanOrchestrator(pipeline);   // : ILogicalOrchestrator
> return OperationResult<ILogicalOrchestrator>.Ok(orchestrator);
> ```
>
> ### Constructor (loads FlowIndex + PromptFlowIndex)
>
> ```csharp
> public OrchestrationPlanMachine(string? privateCorpusDir = null)
> {
>     // Load FlowIndex and PromptFlowIndex from ALL FLOW docs and prompt files in privateCorpusDir.
>     // Both are deterministic and do not affect trained ML weights.
>     if (privateCorpusDir is not null)
>         (_flowIndex, _promptFlowIndex) = OrchestrationCorpusAudit.LoadFlowIndexAndPromptIndex(privateCorpusDir);
> }
> ```
>
> ### SaveCheckpointAsync / LoadCheckpointAsync
> Saves ML state only (`_patternMap`, `_knn`). FlowIndex reloaded from corpus dir on
> next construction (private corpus, not committed to git).
>
> ---
>
> ## Step 3 — TrainedRouteComposerUnit + OrchestrationPlanOrchestrator
>
> **TrainedRouteComposerUnit : IRouteComposerUnit**
> - `ExecuteAsync(request)` → calls `_machine.GeneratePlan(request.Input.Request.UserPrompt)`
>   (full raw user prompt, not `Intent.Goal` which may be normalized/truncated) → three-mode dispatch
> - `HasEnoughStructure`:
>   - `true` when plan text contains ≥ 2 phase labels OR ≥ 1 gate label (retrieval or trained output)
>   - `false` when output is empty or resembles Bootstrap template header only
>   (this prevents `OrchestrationVerifier` from accepting structureless plans)
> - `Warnings: []` normally; `["retrieval_miss_fallback_to_mode2"]` when FLOW ref detected but
>   FlowIndex lookup returned null
>
> **OrchestrationPlanOrchestrator : ILogicalOrchestrator**
> - `FlowId = "orchestration-plan-orchestrator"`
> - Follows `ProjectLocalWikiOrchestrator` pattern
> - `RunAsync(request, ct)` → extracts UserPrompt + ActiveProjectRoot from Metadata → calls `_pipeline.OrchestrateAsync(...)` → maps to `LogicalOrchestratorResult`
>
> ---
>
> ## Step 4 — OrchestrationPilotLoopRunner (OrchestrationPilotLoopRunner.cs)
>
> Mirrors TatoebaPilotLoopRunner:
>
> ```csharp
> public sealed record OrchestrationPilotLoopRunOptions(
>     string PrivatePairsPath,
>     string? PrivateCorpusDir = null,         // for FlowIndex + PromptFlowIndex loading on resume
>     int TrainSetSize = 50,                   // 50-pair batches (documentation-learning discipline)
>     int TestSetSize = 50,
>     int MaxCycles = 29,
>     double RetrievalTarget = 0.90,           // knownFlowRetrievalRouteAccuracy gate (routing quality)
>     double StyleTarget = 0.75,               // unseenStyleAccuracy = overallTrainingAccuracy gate
>     double ExplanationTarget = 0.70,         // humanExplanationAccuracy gate (Mode 3)
>     string? CheckpointPath = null,
>     bool RequireCheckpointResume = false,
>     OrchestrationCheckpointCache? Cache = null);
> ```
>
> - Cache-first → disk → fresh/fail startup (FIX-1 pattern from TranslationMachine)
> - On resume: restore cursor + lastCompletedCycle + acceptedPairIds; do NOT re-run initial training
> - Each cycle: select 50 Mode 2 test pairs (no FlowRef overlap with training, similarity ≥ 0.70)
> - Promote when: `newStructuralTokenRate > 0.25` AND `seenFlowRate < 0.75`
> - Save checkpoint on each promotion + at end of run
>
> **OnCycleCompleted**:
> ```
> ORCH_ACCURACY_SET cycle=N train_rows=N mode2_test_rows=N mode3_test_rows=N
>   routeMode=KnownFlowRetrieval|Mode2Generalization|Mode3HumanExplanation   [per-pair field in detail log]
>   retrievalSource=FlowIndex|PromptFlowIndex|None                           [per-pair field in detail log]
>   mlGenerated=true|false                                                    [per-pair field in detail log]
>   knownFlowRetrievalRouteAccuracy=0.NNN  [routing metric — NOT training accuracy]
>   overallTrainingAccuracy=0.NNN          [= unseenStyleAccuracy, Mode 2 only]
>   unseenStyleAccuracy=0.NNN
>   humanExplanationAccuracy=0.NNN|SKIPPED_NO_MODE3_PAIRS
>   phaseCountAccuracy=0.NNN artifactRecall=0.NNN gateSequenceAccuracy=0.NNN
>   stackRefAccuracy=0.NNN taskTypeRecall=0.NNN|SKIPPED
>   newStructuralTokenRate=0.NNN seenFlowRate=0.NNN
>   promotedToTraining=true|false promotionDecision=PROMOTE|HOLD
>   flowIndexLoaded=true flowIndexSource=<path> trainedStateLoaded=true|false
> ```
>

Проверила v6 мысленно на реальных `user prompts` и grok-примерах. Вердикт: **v6 сильно лучше, но всё ещё недостаточно точно держит границу “человеческая команда” vs “машинный токен”**.

Главная проблема: v6 добавил `HumanExplanationIntentDetector`, но это закрывает только один человеческий режим: “объясни/разбери по-человечески”. А в `user prompts` есть ещё несколько человеческих режимов, которые нельзя сводить к `KnownFlowRetrieval` или `Generalization`.

**Что Теперь Работает Лучше**

- `33-system initiation.md объясни` → Mode 3, не FLOW-33 canonical retrieval. Хорошо.
- `flow 33`, `33*`, `31-*`, `1-st flow` → Mode 1 retrieval. Хорошо.
- `knownFlowRetrievalRouteAccuracy` отделён от `overallTrainingAccuracy`. Хорошо.
- `Mode 1 is deterministic, not ML` явно записано. Хорошо.
- `request.Input.Request.UserPrompt`, не `Intent.Goal`. Хорошо.

**Что Всё Ещё Сломается**

| Реальный prompt | Что человек имеет в виду | Что v6 может сделать |
|---|---|---|
| `flow 33 ... 34 will be later, not now` | FLOW-33 разрешён, FLOW-34 запрещён сейчас | Найдёт FLOW-33, но не извлечёт `forbidden_scope=FLOW-34` |
| `proceed 2.5 phase only` | продолжить только конкретную фазу | Нет отдельного `PhaseContinuation` intent |
| `Please load planning/testing skills` | session init / загрузка навыков | Может уйти в plan/generalization |
| `translate current xiigen implementation (flow 33) from python/react native to node/react` | documentation migration/adaptation | Может принять `flow 33` как canonical FLOW retrieval |
| `do not reset files`, `done so far.zip`, `download after each phase` | строгие execution boundaries | Не извлекаются как first-class constraints |

То есть v6 хорошо различает **canonical retrieval vs human explanation**, но ещё не различает **планирование, продолжение фазы, миграцию документов, загрузку skills, approval gates, forbidden scope**.

**Критичные Дыры В Плане**

1. **Нужен `HumanIntentBoundaryClassifier`, не только `HumanExplanationIntentDetector`.**
   Он должен извлекать:

   ```text
   intent_kind:
     known_flow_planning
     phase_continuation
     documentation_migration
     human_orchestration_explanation
     skill_load_session_init
     architecture_review
     testing_plan
   ```

   И constraints:

   ```text
   allowed_scope
   forbidden_scope
   phase_only
   do_not_proceed_until_approval
   save_state_required
   downloadable_artifact_required
   do_not_reset_existing_files
   attached_files_are_context_or_noise
   ```

2. **PromptFlowIndex сейчас хранит только `prompt -> FlowRef`. Этого мало.**
   В `accepted orchestration pattertns.md` есть не просто FlowRef, а accepted orchestration:
   “FLOW-34 attachments are noise, only FLOW-33 now, save state, approval after each phase”.
   Нужно хранить:

   ```text
   prompt -> OrchestrationIntentContract
   ```

   а не только `prompt -> FLOW-33`.

3. **Mode 3 corpus source path описан неправильно.**
   План говорит искать grok examples через `_workset.csv`, но перечисленные тобой файлы лежат прямо в:

   ```text
   C:\Users\lubao\Documents\xiigen\claude-sessions\grok  orchestrator
   ```

   Нужно явно добавить этот folder в Source table и audit sweep.

4. **DescribeAnalysisProcess требует session context.**
   Prompt `как ты анализировал файлы?` сам по себе не содержит файлов. Он зависит от предыдущего ответа. Mode 3 pair должен хранить `PreviousAssistantAnswer` или `ConversationContext`.

5. **Checkpoint сохраняет не весь ML state.**
   В SaveCheckpoint написано: saves `_patternMap`, `_knn`. Но Mode 3 учится в `_humanExplanationKnn`. Его тоже надо сохранять/загружать, иначе Mode 3 пропадёт после resume.

6. **Нет resume Gate B.**
   После всех наших проблем с checkpoint нельзя ограничиться “checkpoint written”. Нужен второй запуск с `--require-checkpoint-resume` и assert:
   `trainedStateLoaded=true`, `replayed_cycles=0`, cursor restored, Mode2/Mode3 still work.

7. **`EvaluateAsync` contract не поддерживает три метрики.**
   `ILearningMachine.EvaluateAsync` возвращает `LearningEvaluationResult` с одной `Accuracy`. План хочет три метрики. Нужно добавить domain-specific `EvaluateDetailedAsync` или runner report DTO, а `EvaluateAsync.Accuracy = overallTrainingAccuracy`.

8. **`noMachineJargon` для Mode 3 слишком грубый.**
   В accepted human explanations есть `BFA`, `SESSION`, `T47`, `DPO`, но они объяснены человечески. Метрика должна быть не `noMachineJargon`, а `unexplainedMachineJargonRate` или `humanReadableStructureScore`.

**Мысленный Итог**

На кейсе:

```text
We would like to start development from flow 33...
Please read 33* files carefully!!! 34 will be at later stages, not now!!!
```

v6 найдёт FLOW-33, но **не гарантирует**, что FLOW-34 будет запрещён как scope-noise. Это была уже зафиксированная ошибка в accepted patterns.

На кейсе:

```text
Please proceed 2.5 phase only
```

v6 вообще не имеет правильного intent route.

На кейсе:

```text
33-system initiation.md объясни проект
```

v6 уже сработает правильно: Mode 3.

**Вердикт**

v6 можно считать хорошей архитектурной базой, но **не executor-ready**. Нужно добавить четвёртый слой перед всеми modes:

```text
HumanIntentBoundaryClassifier
```

И уже после него выбирать:

```text
KnownFlowRetrieval
Mode2Generalization
HumanOrchestrationExplanation
PhaseContinuation
DocumentationMigration
SkillLoadSessionInit
```

Самое важное правило для плана:

```text
Human intent and explicit boundaries win over machine artifacts and attached file names.
```

Без этого модель снова будет “видеть FLOW/phase/file token” и терять человеческое ограничение.

>
> ## Architectural insight (why two modes are required)
>
> For FLOW-33 a user prompt like "start development from flow 33, read 33* files carefully"
> must produce: sentinel idempotency key, 7 plan docs in /plans/, Bootstrap Kernel lifecycle
> GENERATED→INJECTED→MINIMAL→CORE, 5 parallel arbiters, max 10 iterations per family.
>
> None of these details can be reconstructed from a model trained on other FLOWs.
> Without retrieval, held-out FLOWs always produce generic style, never canonical structure.
>
> **Mandatory boundary layer + three output modes + six compliance metrics:**
>
> `HumanIntentBoundaryClassifier` runs FIRST on every prompt — before FLOW detection.
> It produces `IntentBoundaryContract` containing:
> - `IntentKind` (8 values): `KnownFlowPlanning | PhaseContinuation | DocumentationMigration |
>   HumanOrchestrationExplanation | SkillLoadSessionInit | ArchitectureReview | TestingPlan |
>   ImplementationExecutionRequest`
> - `HumanConstraints[]` (9 types): `OnlyFlow | ForbiddenFlow | PhaseOnly | DoNotProceedUntilApproval |
>   SaveStateRequired | DownloadableArtifactRequired | DoNotResetExistingFiles |
>   UseAttachedFilesAsContext | IgnoreAttachedFilesAsNoise`
> - `MachineArtifacts`: `FlowRefs[], PhaseRefs[], FileNames[], ZipNames[], PlanNames[], TaskTypeIds[], FactoryIds[]`
>
> `HumanBoundaryResolver` then resolves which facts to trust:
> **human explicit constraint > machine artifact name > inferred retrieval**
> (e.g. prompt "34 not now" + FLOW-34 attachment → `ForbiddenFlow=[FLOW-34]` wins, not attachment)
>
> After resolution, route by `IntentKind`:
>
> | IntentKind → Mode | Label | Source of answer | Primary metric |
> |---|---|---|---|
> | `KnownFlowPlanning` → **Mode 1** | KnownFlowRetrieval (deterministic, NOT ML) | `FlowIndex` lookup, constrained by resolved allowed scope | `knownFlowRetrievalRouteAccuracy` (routing metric only) |
> | `PhaseContinuation \| DocumentationMigration \| ArchitectureReview \| TestingPlan \| ImplementationExecutionRequest` → **Mode 2** | Generalization (ML) | KNN + PatternMap; respects extracted `PhaseOnly`, `ForbiddenFlow` constraints | `unseenStyleAccuracy` = `overallTrainingAccuracy` |
> | `HumanOrchestrationExplanation` → **Mode 3** | HumanOrchestrationExplanation (ML) | KNN over grok explanation corpus | `humanExplanationAccuracy` |
> | `SkillLoadSessionInit` → **bypass** | Not orchestration generation; return empty/passthrough | No generation attempted | counted in `intentKindAccuracy` |
>
> **Six compliance metrics** (in addition to three mode metrics):
> - `humanIntentAccuracy` — classifier routed to correct IntentKind
> - `scopeBoundaryAccuracy` — extracted allowed/forbidden scope matches ground truth
> - `forbiddenScopeViolationRate` — hard gate: must be **0.0** (never generate plan including forbidden FLOW/phase)
> - `phaseOnlyCompliance` — hard gate: must be **1.0** (if PhaseOnly constraint present, output covers only that phase)
> - `approvalGateCompliance` — hard gate: must be **1.0** (if DoNotProceedUntilApproval, output must not generate execution)
> - `artifactNoiseResistance` — machine artifact names in attached files do not override human constraints
>
> All modes use `TrainedRouteComposerUnit : IRouteComposerUnit` as the single injection point.
>
> ---
>
> ## Context
>
> `TaskOrchestrationUnit` step 5: `IRouteComposerUnit` (interface in
> `OrchestrationUnitContracts.cs`). `BootstrapRouteComposerUnit` produces a generic
> Russian-language template without FLOW-specific structure. The class is
> `TaskOrchestrationUnit` (in `ProjectTaskOrchestrationPipeline.cs`) — NOT a class named
> `ProjectTaskOrchestrationPipeline`. Constructor: `new TaskOrchestrationUnit(routeComposer: ...)`.
> Method: `OrchestrateAsync(request, ct)`.
>
> **Goal**: `OrchestrationMachine` (`ILearningMachine<OrchestrationPlanDomain>`) that trains
> `TrainedRouteComposerUnit` to:
> - In Mode 1 (KnownFlowRetrieval): deterministically look up the canonical FLOW doc and emit exact structure — this is routing, not ML learning
> - In Mode 2 (Generalization): produce a well-structured plan consistent with the FLOW style seen in training — this IS ML learning
> - In Mode 3 (HumanOrchestrationExplanation): produce a human-readable orchestration explanation from attached files — this IS ML learning
>
> `GetOrchestratorAsync()` returns `OperationResult<ILogicalOrchestrator>` —
> `OrchestrationPlanOrchestrator` wrapping `new TaskOrchestrationUnit(routeComposer: trainedUnit)`.

> | `42.ProjectWikiDomain/OrchestrationPilotLoopRunner.cs` | Training loop |
> | `27.TranslationDomain.Tools/Program.cs` | Three new CLI commands |
> | `Tests/OrchestrationPlanTests.cs` | 29 tests |
>

>
> ## HumanIntentBoundaryClassifier (HumanIntentBoundaryClassifier.cs)
>
> `HumanIntentBoundaryClassifier.Classify(string prompt) → IntentBoundaryContract`
>
> **Runs FIRST before any FLOW detection.** Never throws; always returns a contract.
>
> ### Phase 1: Extract MachineArtifacts (passive scan)
> - FlowRefs: all `FLOW-\d{2}`, `flow \d{2}`, `\d{2}\*`, `\d{2}-\w+` patterns
> - PhaseRefs: `phase \d+(\.\d+)?`, `этап \d+`
> - FileNames: `\S+\.(md|zip|json|pdf|cs)` patterns
> - FactoryIds: `SKILLS_FACTORY_\w+`, `_RAG_\w+`, `v\d+\s+E\d+D`
>
> ### Phase 2: Extract HumanConstraints (keyword scan, case-insensitive, RU+EN)
> - `ForbiddenFlow`: "not now", "не сейчас", "later", "позже", "skip", "пропусти" near a FlowRef
> - `PhaseOnly`: "only", "только", "phase X only", "phase X-Y only"
> - `DoNotProceedUntilApproval`: "do not proceed until", "wait for approval", "не идём дальше"
> - `SaveStateRequired`: "save state", "сохрани состояние", "download", "скачай"
> - `DownloadableArtifactRequired`: "zip after", "download after each", "скачать результаты"
> - `DoNotResetExistingFiles`: "do not reset", "не сбрасывай", "не трогай файлы"
> - `IgnoreAttachedFilesAsNoise`: "ignore attachments", "игнорируй вложения"
> - `UseAttachedFilesAsContext`: file bundle names present but no "ignore" keyword
>
> ### Phase 3: Resolve priority (HumanBoundaryResolver)
> - Human explicit constraint > machine artifact name > inferred retrieval
> - If `ForbiddenFlow` constraint contains FLOW-34 AND `MachineFlowRefs` contains FLOW-34 →
>   `ForbiddenFlowScope = [FLOW-34]` (human wins)
> - `AllowedFlowScope = MachineFlowRefs minus ForbiddenFlowScope` (filtered)
>
> ### Phase 4: Classify IntentKind
> - `HumanOrchestrationExplanation`: keywords "по человечески", "объясни", "разобрать", "как анализировал"
>   OR `UseAttachedFilesAsContext` + no planning keywords
> - `SkillLoadSessionInit`: "load skills", "загрузи скилл", "please load", skill file patterns
> - `PhaseContinuation`: `PhaseOnly` constraint present AND planning keywords
> - `DocumentationMigration`: "translate", "migrate", "adapt", "перевести" near FLOW or technology names
> - `KnownFlowPlanning`: `AllowedFlowScope` non-empty AND no PhaseOnly AND no explanation keywords
> - `ImplementationExecutionRequest`: imperative "start", "run", "execute", "implement" without FLOW
> - `ArchitectureReview`, `TestingPlan`: respective keywords; fallback to `Mode 2` route
> - Default: `KnownFlowPlanning` if FLOW ref found; `ImplementationExecutionRequest` otherwise
>
> ---
>
> ## FlowReferenceDetector (FlowReferenceDetector.cs)
>
> `FlowReferenceDetector.Detect(string prompt) → string? flowRef`
>
> Normalizes prompt to uppercase then applies patterns in order; first match wins:
> 1. `FLOW-\d{2}` → canonical `FLOW-NN` (exact)
> 2. `FLOW\s*-?\s*(\d{2})` → normalize to `FLOW-NN` (e.g. `FLOW33`, `flow 33`, `flow-33`)
> 3. `\b(\d{2})\*` → bare number prefix like `33*` or `31-*` → `FLOW-NN`
> 4. `\b(\d{2})-` → file-name prefix like `31-functionality` → `FLOW-NN`
> 5. Ordinal words: `first`→01, `second`→02, `third`→03, … (up to 10th) → `FLOW-NN`
> 6. `(?:the\s+)?(\d{1,2})(?:st|nd|rd|th)\s+flow` → `FLOW-NN`
>
> Returns `null` when no pattern matches (→ Mode 2).
>
> Tests: `FlowReferenceDetector_DetectsExplicitHyphen`, `_DetectsFlowWithSpace`,
> `_DetectsBareStar33`, `_DetectsFilenamePrefix31`, `_DetectsFirstFlowOrdinal`,
> `_ReturnsNullForGenericPrompt` — these 6 are included in the 17-test count.
>
> ---
>
> ## PromptFlowIndex (built in OrchestrationCorpusAudit.cs, stored in OrchestrationPlanMachine)
>
> `PromptFlowIndex` maps normalized prompt text → `FlowRef` for prompts that are
> explicitly linked to a FLOW in the private prompt files.
>
> **Build**: During `LoadFlowIndex`, for each accepted prompt in
> `sonnet-user-prompts/sonnet - accepted user prompts.md`,
> `sonnet-user-prompts/sonnet - approved orchestration.md`,
> `user prompts/accepted orchestration pattertns.md` (typo filename):
> - If the source section heading contains `FLOW-NN` or the workset session name maps to a FLOW,
>   record `Normalize(promptText) → FlowRef`.
>
> **Lookup**: `PromptFlowIndex.TryGetFlow(string prompt, out string? flowRef)` —
> normalize prompt → exact lookup. Used as second trigger in `GeneratePlan`.
>

> ## Contracts (OrchestrationPlanContracts.cs)
>
> ```csharp
> // OrchestrationPlanChosen — structured; not raw text.
> public sealed record OrchestrationPlanChosen(
>     string FlowRef,
>     IReadOnlyList<string> PhaseSequence,
>     IReadOnlyList<string> ArtifactNames,
>     IReadOnlyList<string> GateSequence,
>     IReadOnlyList<string> StackRefs,
>     IReadOnlyList<string> TaskTypes,         // may be empty (Format B); scorer handles
>     IReadOnlyList<string> DependencyFlows,
>     string ChosenText);                      // serialized plan text from above
>
> // OrchestrationPlanPair — one DPO pair.
> public sealed record OrchestrationPlanPair(
>     string PairId,
>     string FlowRef,
>     string Prompt,
>     PairMode Mode,                           // Mode1=Retrieval | Mode2=Generalization
>     OrchestrationPlanChosen Chosen,
>     string RejectedText,
>     string RejectedType);
>
> public enum PairMode { Mode1KnownFlowRetrieval, Mode2Generalization, Mode3HumanExplanation }
>
> // OrchestrationHumanExplanationChosen — structured human-explanation output.
> public sealed record OrchestrationHumanExplanationChosen(
>     string ProblemStatement,                 // "какой запрос/проблема решается"
>     IReadOnlyList<string> FunctionalitySteps, // "постепенное описание функционала"
>     IReadOnlyList<string> DesignDecisions,   // "техническое дизайн-решение"
>     IReadOnlyList<string> ImplementationPhases, // "этапы реализации"
>     string? AnalysisTrace,                   // "как я анализировал файлы" (may be null)
>     string FlowRef,                          // FLOW-NN or ADAPTER-NN inferred from attached files
>     string ChosenText);                      // full human-readable explanation text
>
> // OrchestrationHumanExplanationPair — one Mode 3 DPO (Direct Preference Optimization) pair.
> public sealed record OrchestrationHumanExplanationPair(
>     string PairId,
>     string FlowRef,
>     string PromptText,
>     IReadOnlyList<string> AttachedFileNames,  // e.g. ["33-system initiation.md", "31-input files.zip"]
>     string SourceBundleName,
>     ExpectedIntent Intent,
>     OrchestrationHumanExplanationChosen Chosen,
>     string RejectedText,
>     string RejectedType);
>
> public enum ExpectedIntent { PlanNewFlow, ExplainAttachedFiles, DescribeAnalysisProcess }
>
> // IntentBoundaryContract — output of HumanIntentBoundaryClassifier.
> public sealed record IntentBoundaryContract(
>     IntentKind Kind,
>     IReadOnlyList<HumanConstraintType> HumanConstraints,
>     IReadOnlyList<string> AllowedFlowScope,     // empty = all allowed
>     IReadOnlyList<string> ForbiddenFlowScope,   // must never appear in output
>     IReadOnlyList<string> PhaseScope,           // non-empty = PhaseOnly constraint
>     IReadOnlyList<string> MachineFlowRefs,      // raw machine artifacts found in prompt
>     IReadOnlyList<string> MachineFileNames,     // attached file names
>     bool RequiresApprovalGate,                  // DoNotProceedUntilApproval
>     bool RequiresSaveState,                     // SaveStateRequired
>     bool RequiresDownloadableArtifact);         // DownloadableArtifactRequired
>
> public enum IntentKind
> {
>     KnownFlowPlanning, PhaseContinuation, DocumentationMigration,
>     HumanOrchestrationExplanation, SkillLoadSessionInit,
>     ArchitectureReview, TestingPlan, ImplementationExecutionRequest
> }
>
> public enum HumanConstraintType
> {
>     OnlyFlow, ForbiddenFlow, PhaseOnly, DoNotProceedUntilApproval,
>     SaveStateRequired, DownloadableArtifactRequired, DoNotResetExistingFiles,
>     UseAttachedFilesAsContext, IgnoreAttachedFilesAsNoise
> }
>
> // OrchestrationCheckpointCache — file-stamp key (same pattern as TranslationCheckpointCache).
> // Stores OrchestrationMachineLoadResult (not just Machine) so cursor is restored on cache hit.
> public sealed class OrchestrationCheckpointCache { ... }   // TryGet, Store, Invalidate
>
> // OrchestrationStructureWeights — per-token learned weights for Mode 2 generalization.
> public sealed record OrchestrationStructureWeights(
>     IReadOnlyDictionary<string, float> PhaseWeights,
>     IReadOnlyDictionary<string, float> ArtifactWeights,
>     IReadOnlyDictionary<string, float> GateWeights,
>     IReadOnlyDictionary<string, float> StackWeights);
>

> ## Step 0 — Corpus audit (OrchestrationCorpusAudit.cs)
>
> Read-only. Two audit sweeps:
>
> **Sweep A — FLOW docs** (for Mode 1 + Mode 2):
> For each `.md` in `claude-sessions/claude orchestrator/`:
> 1. Detect format A ("Что мы строим") or B ("ЗАЧЕМ") or UNKNOWN
> 2. Extract format-aware: PhaseSequence, ArtifactNames, GateLabels, StackRefs, TaskTypes, DependencyFlows
> 3. `TrainingReady = PhaseSequence>=2 AND ArtifactNames>=1 AND GateLabels>=1 AND StackRefs>=1`
>
> **Sweep B — Grok explanation sessions** (for Mode 3):
> For each session file reachable from `_workset.csv` where session folder is NOT `claude orchestrator`:
> 1. Detect if session contains an attached-file explanation prompt ("по человечески", "объясни", "разобрать", "как ты анализировал", OR attached file names in message)
> 2. Extract: AttachedFileNames, inferred FlowRef (from file name prefix like `33-`, `31-`), ExpectedIntent
> 3. `ExplanationReady = AttachedFileNames>=1 AND ChosenAnswer non-empty`
>
> Output `orchestration-corpus-audit.json` with both sweeps.
>
> **Audit gates**:
> - `TrainingReadyCount >= 20` (FLOW docs)
> - `ExplanationReadyCount >= 10` (grok sessions; fail-fast only if < 5)
>
> CLI: `audit-orchestration-corpus --source-dir <path> --output <audit.json>`
>
> CLI: `audit-orchestration-corpus --source-dir <path> --output <audit.json>`
>
> ---
>
> ## Step 1 — Corpus builder (OrchestrationCorpusBuilder.cs)
>
> ### Group split (contamination prevention)
> ```
> Training FLOW set:  TrainingReady FLOWs sorted by number → first 70%
> Held-out FLOW set:  last 30% — never in train batches, never in Mode 2 training
> ```
>
> FlowIndex contains ALL FLOWs (not just training ones). The split only governs
> Mode 2 generalization training. Mode 1 retrieval uses FlowIndex for all 42 FLOWs.
>
> ### Pair mode tagging
>
> **Mode 1 pairs** (PairMode.Mode1Retrieval):
> - Prompt: (a) any form of FLOW reference detected by `FlowReferenceDetector` (e.g. `flow 33`,
>   `33* files`, `31-* documents`, `1-st flow`, `FLOW-01`) OR (b) comes from a workset session
>   whose name contains a FLOW number OR (c) matches `PromptFlowIndex`
> - One canonical prompt per FLOW using the actual accepted prompt from private prompt files
>   where available; synthetic `"start development from FLOW-NN"` otherwise
> - Chosen: canonical OrchestrationPlanChosen from that exact FLOW doc
> - These pairs test retrieval accuracy; they are NOT used in ML PatternMap training
> - Built from ALL 42 FLOWs (both training and held-out sets)
>
> **Mode 2 pairs** (PairMode.Mode2Generalization):
> - Prompt: synthetic (first sentence of "Что мы строим"/"ЗАЧЕМ" section, with FLOW-NN stripped out)
>   OR from accepted prompts file (after removing ALL FLOW-NN references including bare numbers)
> - Chosen: OrchestrationPlanChosen from training FLOWs only
> - Built only from 70% training FLOW set (→ `Mode2TrainingPairs`)
> - 30% held-out FLOW set generates `Mode2HeldOutEvalPairs` — used for evaluation only, never trained
>
> ### 8 rejection types (OC-A through OC-H) for Mode 2 pairs only
>
> | Code | RejectedType | How to build |
> |------|-------------|-------------|
> | OC-A | `generic_template` | Real Bootstrap output: `new TaskOrchestrationUnit().OrchestrateAsync(new SubmitUserTaskRequest(UserPrompt=prompt, ActiveProjectRoot=Path.GetTempPath(), LinkedProjectRoots=[], UserFacingEntrypoint="test"), ct)` |
> | OC-B | `wrong_stack` | Replace StackRefs with wrong stack |
> | OC-C | `no_phase_breakdown` | Omit PhaseSequence |
> | OC-D | `wrong_phase_count` | Keep first half of phases only |
> | OC-E | `missing_artifacts` | Omit ArtifactNames |
> | OC-F | `no_gate_sequence` | Omit GateSequence |
> | OC-G | `missing_dependencies` | Omit DependencyFlows; if empty, omit StackRefs |
> | OC-H | `wrong_task_types` | Replace TaskTypes from a different TrainingReady FLOW |
>
> Mode 1 (KnownFlowRetrieval) pairs use only OC-A (generic_template) as rejected (retrieval failed → Bootstrap output).
>
> ### Mode 3 rejection types (OE-A through OE-J)
>
> | Code | RejectedType | How to build |
> |------|-------------|-------------|
> | OE-A | `canonical_dump_instead_of_human` | SerializeChosen of canonical FLOW plan (machine jargon) |
> | OE-B | `generic_template` | Real Bootstrap output (same as OC-A) |
> | OE-C | `wrong_flow_from_attachment` | Explanation from wrong FLOW doc |
> | OE-D | `ignored_attached_files` | Explanation ignoring AttachedFileNames completely |
> | OE-E | `machine_jargon_overload` | Chosen text + inject task IDs T-NNN, schema version numbers |
> | OE-F | `missing_problem_statement` | Omit ProblemStatement |
> | OE-G | `missing_stepwise_functionality` | Omit FunctionalitySteps |
> | OE-H | `missing_design_decisions` | Omit DesignDecisions |
> | OE-I | `missing_implementation_phases` | Omit ImplementationPhases |
> | OE-J | `answered_next_action_instead` | Replace chosen text with "Next step: …" action list |
>
> **Corpus gates**:
> - `Mode1Pairs >= 42` (one per FLOW doc; all 42 FLOWs; routing quality test only)
> - `Mode2TrainingPairs >= 200` (from 70% training FLOW set; ML training)
> - `Mode2HeldOutEvalPairs >= 40` (from 30% held-out FLOW set; evaluation only, never trained)
> - `NoFlowRefOverlap = true` (Mode 2 training prompts contain no FLOW-NN refs and no bare flow numbers)
> - `Mode3ExplanationPairs >= 50` (from grok orchestrator session files; ML training for Mode 3)
>
> CLI: `build-orchestration-corpus --source-dir <path> --audit <audit.json> --output <corpus.jsonl> [--pairs-per-flow 8]`
>

>
> ## Step 2 — OrchestrationPlanMachine (OrchestrationPlanMachine.cs)
>
> ### Internal state
>
> ```csharp
> // FlowIndex: ALL FLOW docs loaded at construction from private corpus path.
> // KnownFlowRetrieval (Mode 1) uses this; NOT part of trained ML weights.
> private readonly Dictionary<string, OrchestrationPlanChosen> _flowIndex;
>
> // PromptFlowIndex: normalized known-prompt text → FlowRef.
> // Second Mode 1 trigger — catches accepted prompts without explicit FLOW number.
> private readonly PromptFlowIndex _promptFlowIndex;
>
> // Mode 2 (generalization) trained state:
> private readonly OrchestrationKnnStore _knn = new();
> private readonly Dictionary<string, OrchestrationStructureWeights> _patternMap = new();
>
> // Mode 3 (human explanation) trained state:
> private readonly OrchestrationKnnStore _humanExplanationKnn = new();
> ```
>
> ### TrainBatchAsync
> - Skip `Mode1KnownFlowRetrieval` pairs — they are deterministic source-authority, not ML
> - For `Mode2Generalization` pairs: tokenize Prompt → update `_patternMap` weights; store in `_knn`
> - For `Mode3HumanExplanation` pairs: tokenize PromptText + AttachedFileNames → store in `_humanExplanationKnn`
>
> Mode 1 pairs contribute to `_flowIndex` deterministically (loaded at construction, not updated by training).
>
> ### EvaluateAsync — three-tier metrics
>
> **Tier 1 — KnownFlowRetrieval routing quality** (pairs where Mode=Mode1KnownFlowRetrieval):
> - Call `GeneratePlan(prompt)` → must route to FlowIndex via detector
> - Score: `retrievalHit = correct FlowRef found AND FlowIndex lookup succeeded`
> - Score: `exactStructureMatch = all 5 structural metrics pass`
> - `knownFlowRetrievalRouteAccuracy = fraction of Mode 1 pairs where retrievalHit AND exactStructureMatch`
> - ⚠ This is a ROUTING metric — it does NOT count toward `overallTrainingAccuracy`
>
> **Tier 2 — Mode 2 style accuracy** (pairs where Mode=Mode2Generalization):
> - Score: 5 FLOW-specific structural metrics
> - `taskTypeRecall` skipped when expected count = 0 (not counted in mean)
> - `phaseCountAccuracy` clamped to [0,1]
> - `unseenStyleAccuracy = mean productAccuracy across Mode 2 held-out pairs`
> - `overallTrainingAccuracy = unseenStyleAccuracy` (Mode 2 ONLY — not mixed with Tier 1)
>
> **Tier 3 — Mode 3 explanation accuracy** (pairs where Mode=Mode3HumanExplanation):
> - Score: 4 metrics: `problemStatementPresent`, `functionalityStepsCount >= 2`, `implementationPhasesCount >= 1`, `noMachineJargon`
> - `humanExplanationAccuracy = mean across Mode 3 test pairs`
>
> **Tier 4 — Boundary compliance metrics** (all pairs; constraint extracted by classifier):
> - `humanIntentAccuracy` = fraction of pairs where classifier routed to correct `IntentKind`
> - `scopeBoundaryAccuracy` = fraction where `AllowedFlowScope` + `ForbiddenFlowScope` match ground truth
> - `forbiddenScopeViolationRate` = fraction where output includes forbidden FLOW/phase (**hard gate: must = 0.0**)
> - `phaseOnlyCompliance` = fraction where PhaseOnly constraint respected (**hard gate: must = 1.0**)
> - `approvalGateCompliance` = fraction where DoNotProceedUntilApproval constraint respected (**hard gate: must = 1.0**)
> - `artifactNoiseResistance` = fraction where machine artifact names did not override human constraints
>
> `PassesGate = knownFlowRetrievalRouteAccuracy >= RetrievalTarget
>            AND unseenStyleAccuracy >= StyleTarget
>            AND humanExplanationAccuracy >= ExplanationTarget
>            AND forbiddenScopeViolationRate = 0.0
>            AND phaseOnlyCompliance = 1.0
>            AND approvalGateCompliance = 1.0`
>
> ### GeneratePlan(prompt) → string (boundary layer + three-mode dispatcher)
>
> ```csharp
> // Step 1: MANDATORY — classify intent and extract constraints BEFORE anything else
> var contract = HumanIntentBoundaryClassifier.Classify(prompt);
>
> // Step 2: Hard-gate SkillLoad — return passthrough, no plan generation
> if (contract.Kind == IntentKind.SkillLoadSessionInit)
>     return GeneratePassthrough(contract);  // NOT a plan; signals bypass to verifier
>
> // Step 3: Human explanation path (Mode 3)
> if (contract.Kind == IntentKind.HumanOrchestrationExplanation)
> {
>     var nearestExplanation = _humanExplanationKnn.FindNearest(prompt);
>     return RenderHumanExplanation(nearestExplanation, contract, prompt);
> }
>
> // Step 4: FLOW lookup (Mode 1) — constrained by resolved allowed/forbidden scope
> var flowRef = contract.AllowedFlowScope.FirstOrDefault()
>     ?? _promptFlowIndex.TryGetFlow(prompt, out var pfi) ? pfi : null;
> if (flowRef is not null && _flowIndex.TryGetValue(flowRef, out var chosen))
> {
>     // Verify FlowRef is not in ForbiddenFlowScope (human constraint wins)
>     if (!contract.ForbiddenFlowScope.Contains(flowRef))
>         return SerializeChosen(chosen);   // Mode 1: deterministic source-authority
> }
>
> // Step 5: Mode 2 — KNN + PatternMap, respects PhaseScope constraint
> var nearest = _knn.FindNearest(prompt);
> return ApplyPatternMapOverlay(nearest, _patternMap, prompt, contract.PhaseScope);
> ```
>
> ### GetOrchestratorAsync → OperationResult\<ILogicalOrchestrator\>
>
> ```csharp
> var trainedComposer = new TrainedRouteComposerUnit(this);         // three-mode dispatcher
> var pipeline = new TaskOrchestrationUnit(routeComposer: trainedComposer);
> var orchestrator = new OrchestrationPlanOrchestrator(pipeline);   // : ILogicalOrchestrator
> return OperationResult<ILogicalOrchestrator>.Ok(orchestrator);
> ```
>
> ### Constructor (loads FlowIndex + PromptFlowIndex)
>
> ```csharp
> public OrchestrationPlanMachine(string? privateCorpusDir = null)
> {
>     // Load FlowIndex and PromptFlowIndex from ALL FLOW docs and prompt files in privateCorpusDir.
>     // Both are deterministic; HumanIntentBoundaryClassifier is stateless (no loading needed).
>     if (privateCorpusDir is not null)
>         (_flowIndex, _promptFlowIndex) = OrchestrationCorpusAudit.LoadFlowIndexAndPromptIndex(privateCorpusDir);
> }
> ```
>
> ### SaveCheckpointAsync / LoadCheckpointAsync
> Saves ML state only (`_patternMap`, `_knn`). FlowIndex reloaded from corpus dir on
> next construction (private corpus, not committed to git).
>
> ---
>
> ## Step 3 — TrainedRouteComposerUnit + OrchestrationPlanOrchestrator
>
> **TrainedRouteComposerUnit : IRouteComposerUnit**
> - `ExecuteAsync(request)` → calls `_machine.GeneratePlan(request.Input.Request.UserPrompt)`
>   (full raw user prompt, not `Intent.Goal` which may be normalized/truncated) → three-mode dispatch
> - `HasEnoughStructure`:
>   - `true` when plan text contains ≥ 2 phase labels OR ≥ 1 gate label (retrieval or trained output)
>   - `false` when output is empty or resembles Bootstrap template header only
>   (this prevents `OrchestrationVerifier` from accepting structureless plans)
> - `Warnings: []` normally; `["retrieval_miss_fallback_to_mode2"]` when FLOW ref detected but
>   FlowIndex lookup returned null
>
> **OrchestrationPlanOrchestrator : ILogicalOrchestrator**
> - `FlowId = "orchestration-plan-orchestrator"`
> - Follows `ProjectLocalWikiOrchestrator` pattern
> - `RunAsync(request, ct)` → extracts UserPrompt + ActiveProjectRoot from Metadata → calls `_pipeline.OrchestrateAsync(...)` → maps to `LogicalOrchestratorResult`
>
> ---
>
> ## Step 4 — OrchestrationPilotLoopRunner (OrchestrationPilotLoopRunner.cs)
>
> Mirrors TatoebaPilotLoopRunner:
>
> ```csharp
> public sealed record OrchestrationPilotLoopRunOptions(
>     string PrivatePairsPath,
>     string? PrivateCorpusDir = null,         // for FlowIndex + PromptFlowIndex loading on resume
>     int TrainSetSize = 50,                   // 50-pair batches (documentation-learning discipline)
>     int TestSetSize = 50,
>     int MaxCycles = 29,
>     double RetrievalTarget = 0.90,           // knownFlowRetrievalRouteAccuracy gate (routing quality)
>     double StyleTarget = 0.75,               // unseenStyleAccuracy = overallTrainingAccuracy gate
>     double ExplanationTarget = 0.70,         // humanExplanationAccuracy gate (Mode 3)
>     string? CheckpointPath = null,
>     bool RequireCheckpointResume = false,
>     OrchestrationCheckpointCache? Cache = null);
> ```
>
> - Cache-first → disk → fresh/fail startup (FIX-1 pattern from TranslationMachine)
> - On resume: restore cursor + lastCompletedCycle + acceptedPairIds; do NOT re-run initial training
> - Each cycle: select 50 Mode 2 test pairs (no FlowRef overlap with training, similarity ≥ 0.70)
> - Promote when: `newStructuralTokenRate > 0.25` AND `seenFlowRate < 0.75`
> - Save checkpoint on each promotion + at end of run
>
> **OnCycleCompleted**:
> ```
> ORCH_ACCURACY_SET cycle=N train_rows=N mode2_test_rows=N mode3_test_rows=N
>   routeMode=KnownFlowRetrieval|Mode2Generalization|Mode3HumanExplanation|Passthrough [per-pair detail]
>   retrievalSource=FlowIndex|PromptFlowIndex|None                                      [per-pair detail]
>   mlGenerated=true|false                                                               [per-pair detail]
>   intentKind=KnownFlowPlanning|PhaseContinuation|...                                  [per-pair detail]
>   --- mode accuracy ---
>   knownFlowRetrievalRouteAccuracy=0.NNN  [routing metric — NOT training accuracy]
>   overallTrainingAccuracy=0.NNN          [= unseenStyleAccuracy, Mode 2 only]
>   unseenStyleAccuracy=0.NNN
>   humanExplanationAccuracy=0.NNN|SKIPPED_NO_MODE3_PAIRS
>   phaseCountAccuracy=0.NNN artifactRecall=0.NNN gateSequenceAccuracy=0.NNN
>   stackRefAccuracy=0.NNN taskTypeRecall=0.NNN|SKIPPED
>   --- compliance hard gates (must reach target before passesGate) ---
>   forbiddenScopeViolationRate=0.NNN      [hard gate: must = 0.000]
>   phaseOnlyCompliance=0.NNN             [hard gate: must = 1.000]
>   approvalGateCompliance=0.NNN          [hard gate: must = 1.000]
>   --- soft compliance ---
>   humanIntentAccuracy=0.NNN scopeBoundaryAccuracy=0.NNN artifactNoiseResistance=0.NNN
>   --- promotion ---
>   newStructuralTokenRate=0.NNN seenFlowRate=0.NNN
>   promotedToTraining=true|false promotionDecision=PROMOTE|HOLD
>   flowIndexLoaded=true flowIndexSource=<path> trainedStateLoaded=true|false
> ```
>

> ## Step 5 — CLI commands (27.TranslationDomain.Tools/Program.cs)
>
> ```

<details><summary>1 previous message</summary>

> Смотрю v7 как финальный dry-run и как plan-review на противоречия. Он заметно ближе: появилась обязательная boundary layer, но я проверяю, не остались ли старые “дырки в документах” и не создаёт ли новый classifier слишком широкие правила.
</details>

v7 стал уже почти “в правильной форме”: boundary layer наконец стоит перед FLOW detection, и это главное. Но **executor-ready всё ещё нет**. Остались несколько технических дыр, причём часть из них прямо сломает реальные кейсы.

**Критичные Дыры**

1. **`34 not now` всё ещё не поймается.**
   В реальном prompt:
   `Please read 33* files carefully!!! 34 will be at later stages, not now!!!`

   По правилам v7 `33*` станет `FLOW-33`, но bare `34` без `FLOW`, без `*`, без `-` не попадает в `MachineFlowRefs`.
   А тест #22 ожидает `ForbiddenFlowScope=[FLOW-34]`. Сейчас план сам себе противоречит.

   Нужно добавить правило: если рядом с `not now/later/не сейчас/позже` стоит bare number `\b\d{1,2}\b`, нормализовать его как `FLOW-NN`.

2. **Classifier не использует полный `FlowReferenceDetector`.**
   `FlowReferenceDetector` умеет `1-st flow`, ordinals, `31-*`. Но `HumanIntentBoundaryClassifier.Phase 1` заново сканирует FlowRefs своим урезанным списком.
   В итоге unit-test detector может пройти, а `GeneratePlan("start with the 1-st flow")` не уйдёт в FLOW-01.

   Нужно: classifier обязан вызывать `FlowReferenceDetector` или общий `DetectAll()`.

3. **Checkpoint снова не сохраняет Mode 3.**
   Внутри есть:
   ```csharp
   _humanExplanationKnn
   ```
   но `SaveCheckpointAsync / LoadCheckpointAsync` пишет только:
   ```text
   _patternMap, _knn
   ```
   Значит после resume Mode 3 потеряется. Это та же архитектурная дыра, только в новом виде. Нужно сохранять `_humanExplanationKnn` тоже.

4. **Нет resume Gate B.**
   Gate B проверяет первый run, где `trainedStateLoaded=false`. Но не проверяет второй запуск с тем же checkpoint:
   ```text
   --require-checkpoint-resume
   trainedStateLoaded=true
   replayed_cycles=0
   cursor restored
   Mode2 still works
   Mode3 still works
   ```
   Без этого checkpoint-resume опять не доказан.

5. **`EvaluateAsync` contract не поддерживает все метрики.**
   `ILearningMachine.EvaluateAsync` возвращает один `LearningEvaluationResult.Accuracy`. v7 требует 3 mode metrics + 6 compliance metrics. Нужно явно добавить:
   ```text
   EvaluateDetailedAsync → OrchestrationEvaluationReport
   EvaluateAsync.Accuracy = overallTrainingAccuracy
   ```
   И runner должен брать detailed report.

6. **`TrainBatchAsync` не знает mode из стандартного `LearningBatch`.**
   `LearningTrainingItem` имеет только `Prompt`, `ChosenResponse`, `RejectedResponse`. Там нет `PairMode`, constraints, attached files. План говорит “skip Mode1 / train Mode2 / train Mode3”, но не описывает, откуда machine узнаёт mode.
   Нужно либо domain-specific batch DTO, либо JSON envelope inside `ChosenResponse/Prompt`.

7. **Gate B stale/count drift.**
   План пишет `29 tests`, но Gate B section говорит:
   ```text
   # B.3 — All 21 new tests
   ```
   и `FlowReferenceDetector` section говорит “included in the 17-test count”. Это надо вычистить.

8. **Mode3 source path всё ещё неполный.**
   Step 0 ищет grok examples через `_workset.csv`, но реальные файлы лежат прямо тут:
   ```text
   C:\Users\lubao\Documents\xiigen\claude-sessions\grok  orchestrator
   ```
   Этот folder должен быть explicit source, иначе Mode3 corpus может не собраться.

**Семантическая Дыра**

`DoNotProceedUntilApproval` не всегда значит “passthrough/no plan”. В реальных prompt часто смысл такой:

> “Сделай план, но не исполняй дальше без approval.”

То есть правильный output = план + stop boundary, а не пустой passthrough.
Тест #28 надо уточнить: “no execution beyond approved phase”, а не “no plan generated”.

**Что Уже Хорошо**

- Boundary layer first — правильно.
- Human constraint > machine artifact — правильно.
- KnownFlowRetrieval не считается ML accuracy — правильно.
- Mode 2 accuracy отдельно от retrieval — правильно.
- Mode 3 добавлен — правильно.
- `request.Input.Request.UserPrompt` — правильно.
- Forbidden scope, phase-only, approval compliance вынесены в hard gates — правильно.

**Вердикт**

v7 архитектурно уже близок, но **не отдавать executor** до правок выше. Самые обязательные фиксы:

1. bare-number forbidden flow: `34 not now` → `FLOW-34`;
2. classifier uses full FlowReferenceDetector;
3. checkpoint saves `_humanExplanationKnn`;
4. second resume Gate B;
5. detailed evaluation report;
6. mode metadata in training/eval items;
7. explicit `grok  orchestrator` source;
8. approval gate means “plan allowed, execution forbidden”.

После этих правок план будет уже действительно близок к исполнению.

Проверила v8 мысленным прогоном по реальным строкам из `user prompts`, `prompt-orchestration` и `grok  orchestrator`.

Вердикт: v8 стала намного ближе, но я бы ещё не отдавала executor-subagent. Главная архитектура правильная: boundary layer первым, Mode 1 не считается обучением, Mode 2 = реальная training accuracy, Mode 3 отделяет человеческое объяснение от машинного FLOW-плана. Но на реальных кейсах остаются несколько мест, где план всё ещё может перепутать человеческий язык и машинные артефакты.

| `31-* documents attached` | Если это planning request - Mode 1; если “объясни” - Mode 3 | v8 может отправить attachment-only prompt в Mode 3 из-за `UseAttachedFilesAsContext + no planning keywords` | Неоднозначно |
| `Please load planning and testing skills` | SkillLoadSessionInit, passthrough, не план | v8 правильно делает bypass | Проходит |

**Что надо поправить в v9**
1. Добавить `FlowReferenceDetector.DetectAll()` и заставить `HumanIntentBoundaryClassifier` использовать его. Сейчас classifier и detector живут раздельно, поэтому `1-st flow` может пройти unit-test детектора, но не пройти реальную маршрутизацию.

2. Добавить правило bare forbidden flow: число рядом с `not now`, `later`, `не сейчас`, `позже`, `skip`, `пропусти` нормализуется в `FLOW-NN`. Иначе главный кейс `34 will be at later stages, not now` не закрыт.

3. Исправить `PromptFlowIndex`: в тексте он уже хранит `OrchestrationIntentContract`, но в код-блоке всё ещё вызывается `TryGetFlow`, а `OrchestrationIntentContract` не определён. Нужно единообразно: либо `IntentBoundaryContract`, либо новый record, но с явным merge-алгоритмом.

4. Файлы-вложения сами по себе не должны автоматически означать Mode 3. Mode 3 должен срабатывать на `объясни/по человечески/как анализировал` или known grok prompt contract. Иначе `31-* documents attached` конфликтует с retrieval fixture.

5. Approval gate не должен превращать нормальный план в passthrough. Для реального Flow 33 пользователь просит “сделай план, но не продолжай без approve”. Значит output должен быть plan + approval barrier, а не “no plan generated”. Test 28 лучше переписать.

6. Добавить PhaseContinuation patterns: `phase 1-2.4 are done, proceed 2.5 only`, `finished phase 5, start phase 6`, `phase 9 to 4-5 sub-phases`.

7. Gate B поправить мелко, но важно: заголовок `All 21 new tests` устарел, должно быть 29; B.1 должен явно проверять `Mode3ExplanationPairs >= 50`; B.5 должен передавать `--explanation-target 0.70`.

Итого: v8 концептуально правильная, особенно по разделению человеческого объяснения и машинной canonical orchestration. Но на двух центральных реальных границах - `34 not now` и attachment-only vs explanation - ещё есть риск неправильного route. Я бы делала v9 с этими точечными правками перед executor work order.

Да, проверила. Короткий вердикт: v8 **лучше v7**, но ещё **не executor-ready**. Она уже явно отделяет детерминированную source-authority retrieval от обучаемой части, но всё ещё есть места, где детерминизм может замаскироваться под обучение, и есть незакрытые replay/checkpoint риски из той же семьи, что были в переводах.

**1. Детерминизм vs обучение**

Детерминизм в v8 не весь плохой. `FlowIndex`, `FlowReferenceDetector`, `PromptFlowIndex`, `HumanIntentBoundaryClassifier` — это допустимо как boundary/source-authority слой. Но он должен считаться routing/compliance, а не learning.

Проблемные места:

- `PromptFlowIndex` хранит accepted prompt → full contract. Это может решить реальные известные промпты lookup-ом, а не обучением. Нужно явно запретить использовать `PromptFlowIndex` в `overallTrainingAccuracy` и Mode 2 held-out eval. В Gate B должен быть assert: для Mode 2 eval `retrievalSource=None`, `mlGenerated=true`.

- Mode 3 сейчас описан как `_humanExplanationKnn.FindNearest(prompt)` + render. Это ближе к retrieval, чем к обучаемой единице. Для “по человечески объясни” модель может просто возвращать ближайший готовый human explanation. Нужно добавить обучаемое состояние для Mode 3, например `_humanExplanationPatternMap` / structure weights: `ProblemStatement`, `FunctionalitySteps`, `DesignDecisions`, `ImplementationPhases`, `AnalysisTrace`. И checkpoint должен сохранять именно это тоже.

- Tests heavily cover classifier/detector, но мало доказывают learning delta. Нужны отдельные tests: до обучения Mode 2/Mode 3 не проходит, после `TrainBatchAsync` проходит, после save/load всё ещё проходит, и на prompt, которого не было exact в training rows.

- `GeneratePlan(prompt) → string` как публичный метод опасен: теряются `routeMode`, `retrievalSource`, `mlGenerated`, warning/reason. Лучше `GeneratePlanAsync(...) -> OperationResult<OrchestrationGenerationResult>`, где result содержит текст и routing metadata. Иначе Gate B не сможет доказать, что ответ был ML, а не lookup.

**2. Checkpoint / replay**

v8 закрывает часть translation-ошибок: есть checkpoint, cache-first, `_humanExplanationKnn` добавлен в save/load, есть B.6 resume gate. Но ещё не хватает жёстких anti-replay контрактов.

Обязательные добавления:

- В Contracts явно определить `OrchestrationLoopCheckpoint`. Сейчас он упоминается в `OrchestrationMachineLoadResult`, но структура не задана. Нужны поля минимум: `PrivatePairsPath`, `LastCompletedCycle`, `Cursor`, `AcceptedPairIds`, `SkippedPairIds`, возможно отдельно `Mode2AcceptedPairIds`, `Mode3AcceptedPairIds`.

- После promotion checkpoint должен сохранять **реальные accepted pair ids**, не пустой список. Это была точная проблема в translation phase: checkpoint есть, cursor есть, но accepted rows пустые. Добавить Gate B/assert: `acceptedPairIds.Count > 0` после первого promotion.

- Resume должен восстанавливать training set по `AcceptedPairIds`, а не через `rows.Take(cursor)`. Добавить явное правило и test: `ResumeRebuildsTrainingRowsFromAcceptedPairIds_NotCursorPrefix`.

- При `--require-checkpoint-resume`: если checkpoint найден, но loop state отсутствует или повреждён, fail. Нельзя quietly start fresh.

- Cache должен хранить `OrchestrationMachineLoadResult`, не только machine, и после каждого successful save делать `Invalidate(path)` + `Store(path, loadResult)`. В v8 это заявлено, но стоит прописать как обязательную runner step.

- B.6 resume gate должен проверять не только `cursor > 0`, а ещё:
  - `initialTrainingSkippedDueCheckpoint = true`
  - `acceptedPairIdsRestoredCount > 0`
  - `trainingRowsRebuiltFromAcceptedIds = true`
  - `replayed_cycles = 0`
  - `mode2PairsRestored > 0`
  - если Mode 3 training был, `mode3PairsRestored > 0`

**3. Реальные кейсы**

- `flow 33 ... 33* ... 34 later, not now`: v8 всё ещё рискованна, потому что MachineArtifacts не ловит bare `34` как `FLOW-34`, если рядом `not now/later`. Нужно добавить правило bare forbidden number near forbidden keyword.

- `phase 1-2.4 are done, proceed 2.5 phase only`: нужно различать completed range и target phase. Сейчас есть риск взять весь `1-2.4` как scope.

- `33-system initiation.md объясни проект`: v8 правильно отправляет в Mode 3.

- `load planning skills`: правильно passthrough.

- `translate flow 33 from python/react native to node/react`: правильно не canonical retrieval, а DocumentationMigration/Mode 2.

Итого: архитектурная идея v8 правильная, но я бы не запускала executor до v9. Главные правки: доказать learning отдельно от lookup, добавить Mode 3 trainable state, формализовать loop checkpoint с accepted ids, запретить `rows.Take(cursor)`-style resume, и усилить Gate B resume/evidence.

> ## Architectural insight (why two modes are required)
>
> For FLOW-33 a user prompt like "start development from flow 33, read 33* files carefully"
> must produce: sentinel idempotency key, 7 plan docs in /plans/, Bootstrap Kernel lifecycle
> GENERATED→INJECTED→MINIMAL→CORE, 5 parallel arbiters, max 10 iterations per family.
>
> None of these details can be reconstructed from a model trained on other FLOWs.
> Without retrieval, held-out FLOWs always produce generic style, never canonical structure.
>
> **Mandatory boundary layer + three output modes + six compliance metrics:**
>
> `HumanIntentBoundaryClassifier` runs FIRST on every prompt — before FLOW detection.
> It produces `IntentBoundaryContract` containing:
> - `IntentKind` (8 values): `KnownFlowPlanning | PhaseContinuation | DocumentationMigration |
>   HumanOrchestrationExplanation | SkillLoadSessionInit | ArchitectureReview | TestingPlan |
>   ImplementationExecutionRequest`
> - `HumanConstraints[]` (9 types): `OnlyFlow | ForbiddenFlow | PhaseOnly | DoNotProceedUntilApproval |
>   SaveStateRequired | DownloadableArtifactRequired | DoNotResetExistingFiles |
>   UseAttachedFilesAsContext | IgnoreAttachedFilesAsNoise`
> - `MachineArtifacts`: `FlowRefs[], PhaseRefs[], FileNames[], ZipNames[], PlanNames[], TaskTypeIds[], FactoryIds[]`
>
> `HumanBoundaryResolver` then resolves which facts to trust:
> **human explicit constraint > machine artifact name > inferred retrieval**
> (e.g. prompt "34 not now" + FLOW-34 attachment → `ForbiddenFlow=[FLOW-34]` wins, not attachment)
>
> After resolution, route by `IntentKind`:
>
> | IntentKind → Mode | Label | Source of answer | Primary metric |
> |---|---|---|---|
> | `KnownFlowPlanning` → **Mode 1** | KnownFlowRetrieval (deterministic, NOT ML) | `FlowIndex` lookup, constrained by resolved allowed scope | `knownFlowRetrievalRouteAccuracy` (routing metric only) |
> | `PhaseContinuation \| DocumentationMigration \| ArchitectureReview \| TestingPlan \| ImplementationExecutionRequest` → **Mode 2** | Generalization (ML) | KNN + PatternMap; respects extracted `PhaseOnly`, `ForbiddenFlow` constraints | `unseenStyleAccuracy` = `overallTrainingAccuracy` |
> | `HumanOrchestrationExplanation` → **Mode 3** | HumanOrchestrationExplanation (ML) | KNN over grok explanation corpus | `humanExplanationAccuracy` |
> | `SkillLoadSessionInit` → **bypass** | Not orchestration generation; return empty/passthrough | No generation attempted | counted in `intentKindAccuracy` |
>
> **Six compliance metrics** (in addition to three mode metrics):
> - `humanIntentAccuracy` — classifier routed to correct IntentKind
> - `scopeBoundaryAccuracy` — extracted allowed/forbidden scope matches ground truth
> - `forbiddenScopeViolationRate` — hard gate: must be **0.0** (never generate plan including forbidden FLOW/phase)
> - `phaseOnlyCompliance` — hard gate: must be **1.0** (if PhaseOnly constraint present, output covers only that phase)
> - `approvalGateCompliance` — hard gate: must be **1.0** (if DoNotProceedUntilApproval, output must not generate execution)
> - `artifactNoiseResistance` — machine artifact names in attached files do not override human constraints
>
> All modes use `TrainedRouteComposerUnit : IRouteComposerUnit` as the single injection point.
>

> ## HumanIntentBoundaryClassifier (HumanIntentBoundaryClassifier.cs)
>
> `HumanIntentBoundaryClassifier.Classify(string prompt) → IntentBoundaryContract`
>
> **Runs FIRST before any FLOW detection.** Never throws; always returns a contract.
>
> ### Phase 1: Extract MachineArtifacts (passive scan — uses FlowReferenceDetector.DetectAll())
> - **FlowRefs**: call `FlowReferenceDetector.DetectAll(prompt)` — shared implementation, not separate regex
>   (this ensures `1-st flow`, `33*`, `31-functionality` are all caught consistently)
> - **ForbiddenCandidates**: use `DetectAll().ForbiddenCandidates` — bare numbers near forbidden keywords
> - PhaseRefs: `phase \d+(\.\d+)?`, `этап \d+`
> - FileNames: `\S+\.(md|zip|json|pdf|cs)` patterns
> - FactoryIds: `SKILLS_FACTORY_\w+`, `_RAG_\w+`, `v\d+\s+E\d+D`
>
> ### Phase 2: Extract HumanConstraints (keyword scan, case-insensitive, RU+EN)
> - `ForbiddenFlow`: "not now", "не сейчас", "later", "позже", "skip", "пропусти" near a FlowRef
>   **OR** near a bare number from `ForbiddenCandidates` (e.g. `34 will be at later stages, not now` → FLOW-34)
> - `PhaseOnly`: "only", "только", "phase X only", "phase X-Y only"
> - `DoNotProceedUntilApproval`: "do not proceed until", "wait for approval", "не идём дальше"
>   — semantics: plan IS generated + stop boundary; output includes PLAN_ONLY marker;
>     `approvalGateCompliance` = 1.0 means execution beyond approved phase NEVER appears in output
> - `SaveStateRequired`: "save state", "сохрани состояние", "download", "скачай"
> - `DownloadableArtifactRequired`: "zip after", "download after each", "скачать результаты"
> - `DoNotResetExistingFiles`: "do not reset", "не сбрасывай", "не трогай файлы"
> - `IgnoreAttachedFilesAsNoise`: "ignore attachments", "игнорируй вложения"
> - `UseAttachedFilesAsContext`: file bundle names present but no "ignore" keyword
>
> ### Phase 3: Resolve priority (HumanBoundaryResolver)
> - Human explicit constraint > machine artifact name > inferred retrieval
> - If `ForbiddenFlow` constraint contains FLOW-34 AND `MachineFlowRefs` contains FLOW-34 →
>   `ForbiddenFlowScope = [FLOW-34]` (human wins)
> - `AllowedFlowScope = MachineFlowRefs minus ForbiddenFlowScope` (filtered)
>
> ### Phase 4: Classify IntentKind
> - `HumanOrchestrationExplanation`: ONLY when:
>   (a) explicit explanation keywords present: "по человечески", "объясни", "разобрать", "как анализировал",
>       "перевести план на человеческий язык", "опиши что делает" OR
>   (b) prompt matches a known grok prompt contract in `PromptFlowIndex` with intent=HumanOrchestrationExplanation
>   ⚠ Attachments alone (`UseAttachedFilesAsContext` without explanation keywords) do NOT trigger Mode 3.
>   Prompt `31-* documents attached` → `UseAttachedFilesAsContext` constraint set, but intent = KnownFlowPlanning
>   (if FlowRef 31 found) or `ImplementationExecutionRequest` (no FlowRef). Never Mode 3 without keywords.
> - `SkillLoadSessionInit`: "load skills", "загрузи скилл", "please load", skill file patterns
> - `PhaseContinuation`: `PhaseOnly` constraint present AND planning keywords. Patterns:
>   - Completed range + target: `phase 1-2.4 are done/finished/ready, proceed/start 2.5 only`
>   - Sequential: `finished phase N, start phase N+1`
>   - Sub-phase: `phase 9 to 4-5 sub-phases`, `phase X to sub-phases Y-Z`
>   - `PhaseScope` = the TARGET phase(s) only (NOT the completed range)
>   - `ForbiddenFlowScope` may include phases listed as "done" (guard against reprocessing)
> - `DocumentationMigration`: "translate", "migrate", "adapt", "перевести" near FLOW or technology names
> - `KnownFlowPlanning`: `AllowedFlowScope` non-empty AND no PhaseOnly AND no explanation keywords
> - `ImplementationExecutionRequest`: imperative "start", "run", "execute", "implement" without FLOW
> - `ArchitectureReview`, `TestingPlan`: respective keywords; fallback to `Mode 2` route
> - Default: `KnownFlowPlanning` if FLOW ref found; `ImplementationExecutionRequest` otherwise
>

> ## FlowReferenceDetector (FlowReferenceDetector.cs)
>
> `FlowReferenceDetector.Detect(string prompt) → string? flowRef` — first FLOW ref or null.
> `FlowReferenceDetector.DetectAll(string prompt) → IReadOnlyList<string> flowRefs` — ALL refs.
>
> Both normalize prompt to uppercase, then apply patterns:
> 1. `FLOW-\d{2}` → canonical `FLOW-NN` (exact)
> 2. `FLOW\s*-?\s*(\d{2})` → normalize to `FLOW-NN` (e.g. `FLOW33`, `flow 33`, `flow-33`)
> 3. `\b(\d{2})\*` → bare number prefix like `33*` or `31-*` → `FLOW-NN`
> 4. `\b(\d{2})-` → file-name prefix like `31-functionality` → `FLOW-NN`
> 5. Ordinal words: `first`→01, `second`→02, `third`→03, … (up to 10th) → `FLOW-NN`
> 6. `(?:the\s+)?(\d{1,2})(?:st|nd|rd|th)\s+flow` → `FLOW-NN`
> 7. **Forbidden-context bare number**: `\b(\d{1,2})\b` adjacent to forbidden keywords
>    (`not now`, `later`, `не сейчас`, `позже`, `skip`) within 10 tokens → tagged as
>    `FLOW-NN` and placed in `ForbiddenCandidate` list by `DetectAll` (used by classifier Phase 2)
>
> `Detect()` returns first non-forbidden match or null.
> `DetectAll()` returns all matches plus `ForbiddenCandidates` list as separate field.
>
> Tests: `FlowReferenceDetector_DetectsExplicitHyphen`, `_DetectsFlowWithSpace`,
> `_DetectsBareStar33`, `_DetectsFilenamePrefix31`, `_DetectsFirstFlowOrdinal`,
> `_ReturnsNullForGenericPrompt` — these 6 are included in the 29-test total count.
>
> ---
>
> ## PromptFlowIndex (built in OrchestrationCorpusAudit.cs, stored in OrchestrationPlanMachine)
>
> `PromptFlowIndex` maps normalized prompt text → `IntentBoundaryContract` for prompts
> that are explicitly linked to a FLOW AND have documented accepted orchestration constraints.
> (Not just FlowRef — includes AllowedScope, ForbiddenScope, PhaseScope, approval gates.)
>
> **Build**: During `LoadFlowIndexAndPromptIndex`, for each accepted prompt in
> `sonnet-user-prompts/sonnet - accepted user prompts.md`,
> `sonnet-user-prompts/sonnet - approved orchestration.md`,
> `user prompts/accepted orchestration pattertns.md` (typo filename):
> - Parse section: extract FlowRef, ForbiddenFlowScope, PhaseScope, RequiresApprovalGate,
>   SaveStateRequired (e.g. "FLOW-34 attachments are noise, only FLOW-33 now, approval after each phase")
> - Record `Normalize(promptText) → IntentBoundaryContract`
>
> **Lookup**: `PromptFlowIndex.TryGetContract(string prompt, out IntentBoundaryContract? contract)` —
> normalize prompt → exact lookup. Returns an `IntentBoundaryContract` (same type produced by
> `HumanIntentBoundaryClassifier`). Used as second trigger in `GeneratePlan` Step 4.
> When found, the known contract is merged with the classifier's contract (known contract wins on
> `AllowedFlowScope`, `ForbiddenFlowScope`; classifier wins on `IntentKind` and `HumanConstraints`).
>
> ---
>
> ## Contracts (OrchestrationPlanContracts.cs)
>
> ```csharp
> // OrchestrationPlanChosen — structured; not raw text.
> public sealed record OrchestrationPlanChosen(
>     string FlowRef,
>     IReadOnlyList<string> PhaseSequence,
>     IReadOnlyList<string> ArtifactNames,
>     IReadOnlyList<string> GateSequence,
>     IReadOnlyList<string> StackRefs,
>     IReadOnlyList<string> TaskTypes,         // may be empty (Format B); scorer handles
>     IReadOnlyList<string> DependencyFlows,
>     string ChosenText);                      // serialized plan text from above
>
> // OrchestrationPlanPair — one DPO pair.
> public sealed record OrchestrationPlanPair(
>     string PairId,
>     string FlowRef,
>     string Prompt,
>     PairMode Mode,                           // Mode1=Retrieval | Mode2=Generalization
>     OrchestrationPlanChosen Chosen,
>     string RejectedText,
>     string RejectedType);
>
> public enum PairMode { Mode1KnownFlowRetrieval, Mode2Generalization, Mode3HumanExplanation }
>
> // OrchestrationHumanExplanationChosen — structured human-explanation output.
> public sealed record OrchestrationHumanExplanationChosen(
>     string ProblemStatement,                 // "какой запрос/проблема решается"
>     IReadOnlyList<string> FunctionalitySteps, // "постепенное описание функционала"
>     IReadOnlyList<string> DesignDecisions,   // "техническое дизайн-решение"
>     IReadOnlyList<string> ImplementationPhases, // "этапы реализации"
>     string? AnalysisTrace,                   // "как я анализировал файлы" (may be null)
>     string FlowRef,                          // FLOW-NN or ADAPTER-NN inferred from attached files
>     string ChosenText);                      // full human-readable explanation text
>
> // OrchestrationHumanExplanationPair — one Mode 3 DPO (Direct Preference Optimization) pair.
> public sealed record OrchestrationHumanExplanationPair(
>     string PairId,
>     string FlowRef,
>     string PromptText,
>     IReadOnlyList<string> AttachedFileNames,  // e.g. ["33-system initiation.md", "31-input files.zip"]
>     string SourceBundleName,
>     string? ConversationContext,             // previous assistant answer (required for DescribeAnalysisProcess intent)
>     ExpectedIntent Intent,
>     OrchestrationHumanExplanationChosen Chosen,
>     string RejectedText,
>     string RejectedType);
>
> public enum ExpectedIntent { PlanNewFlow, ExplainAttachedFiles, DescribeAnalysisProcess }
>
> // IntentBoundaryContract — output of HumanIntentBoundaryClassifier.
> public sealed record IntentBoundaryContract(
>     IntentKind Kind,
>     IReadOnlyList<HumanConstraintType> HumanConstraints,
>     IReadOnlyList<string> AllowedFlowScope,     // empty = all allowed
>     IReadOnlyList<string> ForbiddenFlowScope,   // must never appear in output
>     IReadOnlyList<string> PhaseScope,           // non-empty = PhaseOnly constraint
>     IReadOnlyList<string> MachineFlowRefs,      // raw machine artifacts found in prompt
>     IReadOnlyList<string> MachineFileNames,     // attached file names
>     bool RequiresApprovalGate,                  // DoNotProceedUntilApproval
>     bool RequiresSaveState,                     // SaveStateRequired
>     bool RequiresDownloadableArtifact);         // DownloadableArtifactRequired
>
> public enum IntentKind
> {
>     KnownFlowPlanning, PhaseContinuation, DocumentationMigration,
>     HumanOrchestrationExplanation, SkillLoadSessionInit,
>     ArchitectureReview, TestingPlan, ImplementationExecutionRequest
> }
>
> public enum HumanConstraintType
> {
>     OnlyFlow, ForbiddenFlow, PhaseOnly, DoNotProceedUntilApproval,
>     SaveStateRequired, DownloadableArtifactRequired, DoNotResetExistingFiles,
>     UseAttachedFilesAsContext, IgnoreAttachedFilesAsNoise
> }
>
> // OrchestrationCheckpointCache — file-stamp key (same pattern as TranslationCheckpointCache).
> // Stores OrchestrationMachineLoadResult (not just Machine) so cursor is restored on cache hit.
> public sealed class OrchestrationCheckpointCache { ... }   // TryGet, Store, Invalidate
>
> // OrchestrationStructureWeights — per-token learned weights for Mode 2 generalization.
> public sealed record OrchestrationStructureWeights(
>     IReadOnlyDictionary<string, float> PhaseWeights,
>     IReadOnlyDictionary<string, float> ArtifactWeights,
>     IReadOnlyDictionary<string, float> GateWeights,
>     IReadOnlyDictionary<string, float> StackWeights);
>
> // OrchestrationMachineLoadResult — same pattern as TranslationMachineLoadResult.
> public sealed record OrchestrationMachineLoadResult(
>     OrchestrationPlanMachine Machine,
>     OrchestrationLoopCheckpoint? LoopState);
>
> // OrchestrationEvaluationReport — domain-specific detailed metrics returned by EvaluateDetailedAsync.
> // ILearningMachine.EvaluateAsync.Accuracy = overallTrainingAccuracy (Mode 2 only) per interface contract.
> // All detailed metrics live here; runner logs this to report JSON.
> public sealed record OrchestrationEvaluationReport(
>     double OverallTrainingAccuracy,          // = unseenStyleAccuracy (Mode 2 only) — maps to EvaluateAsync.Accuracy
>     double KnownFlowRetrievalRouteAccuracy,  // routing metric — NOT training accuracy
>     double UnseenStyleAccuracy,
>     double HumanExplanationAccuracy,         // 0 if no Mode 3 pairs; reported as SKIPPED
>     double HumanIntentAccuracy,
>     double ScopeBoundaryAccuracy,
>     double ForbiddenScopeViolationRate,      // hard gate: must = 0.0
>     double PhaseOnlyCompliance,              // hard gate: must = 1.0
>     double ApprovalGateCompliance,           // hard gate: must = 1.0
>     double ArtifactNoiseResistance,
>     bool PassesGate);
> ```
>
