> ## Step 6 — Tests (39, Tests/OrchestrationPlanTests.cs)
>
> | # | Name | Assertion |
> |---|------|-----------|
> | 1 | `OrchestrationCorpusAudit_DetectsFormatA` | FLOW-01 → format=A, TrainingReady=true, all 4 fields non-empty |
> | 2 | `OrchestrationCorpusAudit_DetectsFormatB` | FLOW-04 → format=B, extracts from ЗАЧЕМ/В КАКОМ ПОРЯДКЕ |
> | 3 | `OrchestrationCorpusBuilder_Mode1PairsFromAllFlows` | Mode1Pairs includes both training and held-out FLOWs |
> | 4 | `OrchestrationCorpusBuilder_Mode2PairsFromTrainingOnly` | Mode 2 prompts contain no FLOW-NN refs; FlowRefs only from training set |
> | 5 | `OrchestrationCorpusBuilder_AllEightRejectionTypes` | One Mode 2 Chosen → 8 pairs with distinct OC-A..OC-H; all start with "[WRONG:" |
> | 6 | `OrchestrationMachine_Mode1_ReturnsCanonicaPlanFromFlowIndex` | Machine loaded with corpus dir; prompt "start from FLOW-33" → GeneratePlanAsync returns text containing FLOW-33 phase labels (not Bootstrap template) |
> | 7 | `OrchestrationMachine_Mode1_RecognizesFlow33WithoutHyphen` | Prompt "start development from flow 33, read 33* files" → FlowReferenceDetector returns "FLOW-33" → Mode 1 retrieval |
> | 8 | `OrchestrationMachine_Mode1_RecognizesFlow31FromDocumentPrefix` | Prompt "31-* documents attached" → FlowReferenceDetector returns "FLOW-31" → Mode 1 retrieval |
> | 9 | `OrchestrationMachine_Mode1_RecognizesFirstFlowOrdinal` | Prompt "start with the 1-st flow" → FlowReferenceDetector returns "FLOW-01" → Mode 1 retrieval |
> | 10 | `OrchestrationMachine_Mode2_UsesPatternMapForGenericPrompt` | Train on Mode 2 pair with PhaseSequence; generic prompt (no FLOW ref) → GeneratePlanAsync returns phase labels |

> ## Commit message (phase 37, one commit after Gate B B.0–B.7)
>
> ```
> phase 37: OrchestrationMachine three-mode training foundation
>
> - OrchestrationPlanDomain + OrchestrationPlanContracts:
>   FlowDetectionResult (AllRefs + ForbiddenCandidates typed record),
>   PairMode enum (Mode1KnownFlowRetrieval/Mode2Generalization/Mode3HumanExplanation),
>   OrchestrationHumanExplanationChosen, ExpectedIntent enum,
>   OrchestrationTrainingPair (unified corpus+training envelope; replaces OrchestrationPlanPair + OrchestrationHumanExplanationPair;
>     carries ExpectedBoundary/PlanChosen?/HumanExplanationChosen?/AttachedFileNames?/ConversationContext?/HumanIntent?),
>   OrchestrationTrainingBatch (batch wrapper for domain method),
>   OrchestrationCheckpointCache (stores LoadResult, file-stamp key),
>   OrchestrationStructureWeights, OrchestrationHumanExplanationWeights, OrchestrationMachineLoadResult
> - HumanIntentBoundaryClassifier: mandatory boundary layer (fires first, before FLOW detection);
>   extracts IntentKind (8 types), HumanConstraints (9 types), MachineArtifacts;
>   HumanBoundaryResolver: human explicit constraint > machine artifact > inferred;
>   hard gates: ForbiddenScope never in output, PhaseOnly respected, ApprovalGate respected
> - FlowReferenceDetector: multi-pattern FLOW ref detection
>   (FLOW-33, flow 33, 33*, 31-*, 1-st flow, ordinals 1st..10th)
> - CorpusContaminationAudit (replaces PromptFlowIndex): build-time only; rejects Mode 2/3 training pairs
>   that exactly match accepted orchestration prompt text (prevents lookup-memory contamination)
> - OrchestrationCorpusAudit.LoadFlowIndex (renamed): loads FlowIndex only (no PromptFlowIndex)
> - OrchestrationCorpusAudit: 42-FLOW audit (Format A/B, TrainingReady) +
>   grok session sweep (ExplanationReady), LoadFlowIndex() (renamed from LoadFlowIndexAndPromptIndex)
> - OrchestrationCorpusBuilder:
>   Mode1 pairs from ALL 42 FLOWs (routing test only, NOT training accuracy)
>   Mode2TrainingPairs from 70% training FLOWs; Mode2HeldOutEvalPairs from 30%
>   Mode3ExplanationPairs from grok explanation sessions (>= 50)
>   8 rejection types OC-A..OC-H (Mode 2) + 10 OE-A..OE-J (Mode 3)
>   OC-A / OE-B = real TaskOrchestrationUnit Bootstrap output
>   NoFlowRefOverlap verified for Mode 2 training prompts
> - TrainedRouteComposerUnit: three-mode dispatcher using request.Input.Request.UserPrompt
>   (Mode 3 pre-router fires first; then Mode 1 FlowReferenceDetector only — no PromptFlowIndex;
>    Mode 2 KNN+PatternMap generalization; HasEnoughStructure conditional)
> - OrchestrationPlanOrchestrator: ILogicalOrchestrator wrapping TaskOrchestrationUnit
> - OrchestrationKnnStore: KNN retrieval for Mode 2 (plans) + Mode 3 (explanations)
> - OrchestrationPlanMachine: ILearningMachine<OrchestrationPlanDomain>
>   - Constructor loads FlowIndex from private corpus dir (initial training only); PromptFlowIndex removed
>   - TrainOrchestrationBatchAsync (domain method): Mode 2 (updates _knn + _patternMap) + Mode 3 (updates _humanExplanationKnn + _humanExplanationPatternMap); Mode 1 = deterministic, not gradient
>   - TrainBatchAsync (ILearningMachine adapter): wraps to TrainOrchestrationBatchAsync; never called by runner directly
>   - GeneratePlanAsync → OperationResult<OrchestrationGenerationResult> with RouteMode/RetrievalSource/MlGenerated/IntentKind/Warnings
>   - EvaluateAsync: three-tier; Mode 2 eval asserts retrievalSource=None AND mlGenerated=true;
>     knownFlowRetrievalRouteAccuracy (routing metric, NOT training accuracy);
>     overallTrainingAccuracy = unseenStyleAccuracy (Mode 2 only);
>     humanExplanationAccuracy (Mode 3)
>   - ORCH_ACCURACY_SET prints routeMode/retrievalSource/mlGenerated/intentKind/flowIndexLoaded
>   - Hard gates: forbiddenScopeViolationRate=0, phaseOnlyCompliance=1, approvalGateCompliance=1
>   - GetOrchestratorAsync → TaskOrchestrationUnit(routeComposer: trainedUnit)
>   - Atomic save; FlowIndex not in checkpoint; checkpoint saves _humanExplanationPatternMap
> - OrchestrationLoopCheckpoint: formally defined with PrivatePairsPath, LastCompletedCycle, Cursor,
>   TrainedPairIds (all trained; non-empty after first training cycle), Mode2PromotedPairIds, Mode3PromotedPairIds
> - OrchestrationPilotLoopRunner: three targets (retrieval 0.90, style 0.75, explanation 0.70);
>   TrainedPairIds used for exclusion on resume (NOT re-training); no PromptFlowIndex — boundary = Classifier only;
>   fixture assertions (flow 33, 31-*, 1-st flow, "33-*.md объясни" → Mode 3 not Mode 1)
> - HumanIntentBoundaryClassifier: explicitly non-trainable policy guard; its accuracy metrics are policy
>   compliance metrics (humanIntentAccuracy, forbiddenScopeViolationRate, etc.), not ML accuracy;
>   if a trainable intent router is needed, it is a separate trainable unit — not this classifier
> - PromptFlowIndex: REMOVED from OrchestrationPlanMachine and all production routing;
>   BoundarySource.PromptFlowIndex removed; Step 1a merge removed; Mode 1 "known prompt without FLOW ref" removed;
>   replaced by build-time CorpusContaminationAudit (rejects training pairs that exactly match accepted prompts)
>   Rule: Mode 1 only for explicit FLOW ref (FlowReferenceDetector); all others → Mode 2 (mlGenerated=true)
> - SaveCheckpointAsync: now includes _flowIndex content (42 OrchestrationPlanChosen records embedded);
>   marketplace import requires only checkpoint file, no private corpus dir
> - OrchestrationCorpusAudit.LoadFlowIndex (renamed from LoadFlowIndexAndPromptIndex): FlowIndex only

> ## No-product-decisions check
>
> - Three modes locked:
>   Mode 1 = KnownFlowRetrieval (deterministic source-authority, NOT ML);
>   Mode 2 = Generalization (ML, = overallTrainingAccuracy);
>   Mode 3 = HumanOrchestrationExplanation (ML, measured separately)
> - Mandatory boundary layer: `HumanIntentBoundaryClassifier` fires BEFORE everything else
>   — extracts IntentKind, HumanConstraints (ForbiddenFlow, PhaseOnly, ApprovalGate, etc.), MachineArtifacts
>   — `HumanBoundaryResolver` priority: human explicit constraint > machine artifact > inferred
>   — prompt "33-system initiation.md объясни" → HumanOrchestrationExplanation, NOT KnownFlowPlanning
>   — prompt "34 not now" + FLOW-34 attachment → ForbiddenFlowScope=[FLOW-34] wins
>   — prompt "load skills" → SkillLoadSessionInit → passthrough, no plan generated
> - `knownFlowRetrievalRouteAccuracy` is a ROUTING metric; it does NOT count toward `overallTrainingAccuracy`
> - `overallTrainingAccuracy` = `unseenStyleAccuracy` (Mode 2 only)
> - `ORCH_ACCURACY_SET` prints `routeMode`, `retrievalSource`, `mlGenerated`, `flowIndexLoaded`
> - FlowReferenceDetector: catches `FLOW-NN`, `flow 33`, `33*`, `31-*`, `1-st flow`, ordinals 1st–10th
> - PromptFlowIndex: REMOVED — no known-prompt secondary trigger; Mode 1 = explicit FLOW ref ONLY
> - FlowIndex: embedded in checkpoint (SaveCheckpointAsync section 5); loaded from corpus dir on first training run;
>   restored from checkpoint on import — no private corpus dir needed for marketplace import
> - BoundarySource = always Classifier (only one boundary source now)
> - `EvaluateAsync.Accuracy = overallTrainingAccuracy = unseenStyleAccuracy` (Mode 2 only, per ILearningMachine contract); detailed report via `EvaluateDetailedAsync → OrchestrationEvaluationReport`
> - `unexplainedMachineJargonRate < 0.15` (Mode 3 metric; known terms BFA/DPO/SESSION allowed if explained)
> - Resume Gate B (B.6): second run with `--require-checkpoint-resume`; asserts `trainedStateLoaded=true`, `replayed_cycles=0`, Mode 2+3 intact after reload
> - TrainedRouteComposerUnit reads `request.Input.Request.UserPrompt` (full raw prompt, not `Intent.Goal`)
> - HasEnoughStructure: conditional — false when output structureless
> - TrainBatchAsync: Mode 2 + Mode 3 only; Mode 1 pairs = deterministic FlowIndex (no gradient)
> - EvaluateAsync: three separate metrics with three targets (routing 0.90, style 0.75, explanation 0.70)
> - Corpus naming: `Mode1Pairs` (routing test), `Mode2TrainingPairs` (70%), `Mode2HeldOutEvalPairs` (30%),
>   `Mode3TrainingPairs` (60% of grok), `Mode3HeldOutEvalPairs` (40% of grok), `Mode3ExplanationPairs` (total grok >= 50);
>   split by FlowRef sort order; prompt text overlap is allowed (generic template)
> - NoFlowRefOverlap: Mode 2 training prompts must not contain FLOW-NN refs or bare flow numbers
> - OC-A / OE-B: `new TaskOrchestrationUnit()` Bootstrap output (not ProjectTaskOrchestrationPipeline — filename only)
> - taskTypeRecall: skipped entirely when expected=0
> - phaseCountAccuracy: clamped [0,1]
> - Gate B: knownFlowRetrievalRouteAccuracy >= 0.90; hard gate compliance required EVERY cycle
>   (forbiddenScopeViolationRate=0, phaseOnlyCompliance=1.0, approvalGateCompliance=1.0);

>   `"34 not now"` → FLOW-34 absent from output, `"load skills"` → passthrough;
>   rollingAverage last 3 cycles (not peak); replayed_cycles=0
> - CLI home: 27.TranslationDomain.Tools; no new .csproj; `--explanation-target 0.70` added
> - Checkpoint report: `flowIndexLoaded=true`, `flowIndexSource=<path>`, `trainedStateLoaded=true|false`
> - `GeneratePlanAsync` (not `GeneratePlan`) returns `OperationResult<OrchestrationGenerationResult>`;

> - Mode 3 has `_humanExplanationPatternMap` (`OrchestrationHumanExplanationWeights`) + `_humanExplanationKnn`;

> - `OrchestrationLoopCheckpoint` formal fields: PrivatePairsPath, LastCompletedCycle, Cursor,
>   TrainedPairIds (non-empty after first training cycle), Mode2PromotedPairIds, Mode3PromotedPairIds
> - PromptFlowIndex: REMOVED from GeneratePlanAsync — no Step 1a, no known-prompt upgrade, no merge table;
>   BoundarySource is always Classifier; a prompt without explicit FLOW ref always reaches Mode 2 (mlGenerated=true)
> - Resume: checkpoint load restores ALL ML trained state directly; TrainedPairIds used ONLY for
>   candidate exclusion — TrainOrchestrationBatchAsync NEVER called on restored pairs (replay bug locked out);
>   report must contain resumeTrainBatchCalls=0, trainedPairIdsUsedForExclusionOnly=true, trainedPairIdsRestoredCount>0
> - TrainedPairIds = all pair IDs passed to TrainOrchestrationBatchAsync regardless of promotion decision;
>   Mode2PromotedPairIds / Mode3PromotedPairIds = promotion subsets (may be smaller than TrainedPairIds)
> - Mode 3 corpus builder split: Mode3TrainingPairs >= 30, Mode3HeldOutEvalPairs >= 20;
>   NoMode3SourceBundleOverlap=true, NoMode3FlowRefOverlap=true (prompt text overlap is acceptable — generic template);

> - `BoundarySource` = always `Classifier` (PromptFlowIndex removed); `RetrievalSource` (FlowIndex|None) records where plan content came from

Verdict: **v18 is still not executor-ready.** It covers several fixes, but it does **not** cover all points we discussed.

**Authority Coverage**
| Topic | Status | Why |
|---|---:|---|
| Human/architect requirements are binding, not wishlist | Partial | `AGENTS.md`/skills now cover it, but v18 governance block does not include Authority Requirements Ledger, Conversation Delta Ledger, Replacement Mapping Register, or full Contradiction Sweep. |
| Rule applies beyond “forbid” to every user/architect requirement | Not covered in v18 | v18 still has only ordinary Requirements Ledger, not authority-chain binding for all requirements. |
| Product is for users beyond Luba | Not covered | v18 governance is still framed around Luba/sub-agent execution, not product-owner/user requirement preservation as a product rule. |
| Architect requirements to sub-agents are binding | Partial | OP-41 mentions sub-agent execution, but no required downstream authority ledger/work-order preservation. |
| PromptFlowIndex runtime removed | Covered | Yes, v18 removes PromptFlowIndex from runtime. |
| PromptFlowIndex removal is not enough | Not covered | v18 treats removal as covered requirement R8. That is deletion-only coverage. |
| PromptFlowGroundingModel required | **Missing** | No `PromptFlowGroundingModel`, no `PromptFlowGroundingDomain`, no trained grounding state, no grounding checkpoint/manifest/import/export/locator tests. |
| FlowReferenceDetector/FlowIndex deterministic production routing forbidden | **Contradicted** | v18 still uses `FlowReferenceDetector`, `KnownFlowRetrieval`, `_flowIndex.TryGetValue`, `RetrievalSource.FlowIndex` in `GeneratePlanAsync`. |
| Deterministic helpers only for audit/corpus/eval | Contradicted | v18 uses detector/FlowIndex in production routing and Gate B fixtures. |
| KNN + PatternMap are trained | Mostly covered | Mode 2/3 train KNN and pattern maps, checkpoint them, and test export/import. |
| KNN must not become exact-prompt memory lookup | Partial | CorpusContaminationAudit rejects exact accepted prompt overlap, but tests 37–39 do not fully prove no exact-prompt KNN leakage. Need explicit exact-prompt leakage/ablation gate. |
| HumanIntentBoundaryClassifier non-trainable policy guard | Covered | This part is clearly stated and correctly separated from ML accuracy. |
| Model asset readiness for OrchestrationMachine | Mostly covered | B.7 adds manifest, checkpoint, locator, fresh load, publish/load, continue-training. But it embeds deterministic FlowIndex, so the asset preserves the forbidden mechanism. |
| TranslationMachine asset readiness | **Missing** | v18 only covers OrchestrationPlanMachine. It does not include translator checkpoint/manifest/locator/fresh-load/continue-training readiness. |

**Critical Contradictions**
1. v18 still says: Mode 1 = `KnownFlowRetrieval`, deterministic source-authority, `FlowIndex` lookup.
2. `GeneratePlanAsync` Step 4 still does production `_flowIndex.TryGetValue`.
3. Tests 6–9 still assert detector → Mode 1 retrieval.
4. Gate B still requires `fixture_retrieval["flow 33"] → KnownFlowRetrieval`.
5. Requirements Ledger says PromptFlowIndex removal is covered, but the actual required replacement is PromptFlowGroundingModel.

There are also stale internal contradictions: commit message says “FlowIndex not in checkpoint” while SaveCheckpoint says FlowIndex embedded; test 15 says FlowIndex reloaded from corpus while B.7 requires checkpoint-embedded FlowIndex; CLI count says “three new commands” while the plan lists more.

**Required v19 Repair**
v19 needs to replace deterministic Mode 1 with a trainable `PromptFlowGroundingModel` or explicitly equivalent trainable unit. `FlowReferenceDetector` and `FlowIndex` may stay only for corpus labeling/audit/fixtures/evaluation, not production routing. Add grounding export/import/checkpoint/manifest/locator/fresh-load/continue-training/ablation gates, exact-prompt leakage tests, TranslationMachine asset-readiness scope, and the new authority-chain governance block.

> ## Architectural insight (why two modes are required)
>
> For FLOW-33 a user prompt like "start development from flow 33, read 33* files carefully"
> must produce: sentinel idempotency key, 7 plan docs in /plans/, Bootstrap Kernel lifecycle
> GENERATED→INJECTED→MINIMAL→CORE, 5 parallel arbiters, max 10 iterations per family.
>
> None of these details can be reconstructed from a model trained on other FLOWs.
> Without retrieval, held-out FLOWs always produce generic style, never canonical structure.
>
> **Mandatory boundary layer + three output modes + six compliance metrics:**
>
> `HumanIntentBoundaryClassifier` runs FIRST on every prompt — before FLOW detection.
> It produces `IntentBoundaryContract` containing:
> - `IntentKind` (8 values): `KnownFlowPlanning | PhaseContinuation | DocumentationMigration |
>   HumanOrchestrationExplanation | SkillLoadSessionInit | ArchitectureReview | TestingPlan |
>   ImplementationExecutionRequest`
> - `HumanConstraints[]` (9 types): `OnlyFlow | ForbiddenFlow | PhaseOnly | DoNotProceedUntilApproval |
>   SaveStateRequired | DownloadableArtifactRequired | DoNotResetExistingFiles |
>   UseAttachedFilesAsContext | IgnoreAttachedFilesAsNoise`
> - `MachineArtifacts`: `FlowRefs[], PhaseRefs[], FileNames[], ZipNames[], PlanNames[], TaskTypeIds[], FactoryIds[]`
>
> `HumanBoundaryResolver` then resolves which facts to trust:
> **human explicit constraint > machine artifact name > inferred retrieval**
> (e.g. prompt "34 not now" + FLOW-34 attachment → `ForbiddenFlow=[FLOW-34]` wins, not attachment)
>
> After resolution, route by `IntentKind`:
>
> | IntentKind → Mode | Label | Source of answer | Primary metric |
> |---|---|---|---|
> | `KnownFlowPlanning` → **Mode 1** | LearnedFlowGrounding (ML, trained on FLOW-specific corpus pairs) | KNN + FlowGroundingWeights; prompt + FlowRef hint → FLOW-specific plan | `learnedFlowGroundingAccuracy` (ML metric; counts toward overallTrainingAccuracy) |
> | `PhaseContinuation \| DocumentationMigration \| ArchitectureReview \| TestingPlan \| ImplementationExecutionRequest` → **Mode 2** | Generalization (ML) | KNN + PatternMap; respects extracted `PhaseOnly`, `ForbiddenFlow` constraints | `unseenStyleAccuracy` = `overallTrainingAccuracy` |
> | `HumanOrchestrationExplanation` → **Mode 3** | HumanOrchestrationExplanation (ML) | KNN over grok explanation corpus | `humanExplanationAccuracy` |
> | `SkillLoadSessionInit` → **bypass** | Not orchestration generation; return empty/passthrough | No generation attempted | counted in `intentKindAccuracy` |
>
> **Six compliance metrics** (in addition to three mode metrics):
> - `humanIntentAccuracy` — classifier routed to correct IntentKind
> - `scopeBoundaryAccuracy` — extracted allowed/forbidden scope matches ground truth
> - `forbiddenScopeViolationRate` — hard gate: must be **0.0** (never generate plan including forbidden FLOW/phase)
> - `phaseOnlyCompliance` — hard gate: must be **1.0** (if PhaseOnly constraint present, output covers only that phase)
> - `approvalGateCompliance` — hard gate: must be **1.0** (if DoNotProceedUntilApproval, output must not generate execution)
> - `artifactNoiseResistance` — machine artifact names in attached files do not override human constraints
>
> All modes use `TrainedRouteComposerUnit : IRouteComposerUnit` as the single injection point.
>
> ---
>
> ## Context
>
> `TaskOrchestrationUnit` step 5: `IRouteComposerUnit` (interface in
> `OrchestrationUnitContracts.cs`). `BootstrapRouteComposerUnit` produces a generic
> Russian-language template without FLOW-specific structure. The class is
> `TaskOrchestrationUnit` (in `ProjectTaskOrchestrationPipeline.cs`) — NOT a class named
> `ProjectTaskOrchestrationPipeline`. Constructor: `new TaskOrchestrationUnit(routeComposer: ...)`.
> Method: `OrchestrateAsync(request, ct)`.
>
> **Goal**: `OrchestrationMachine` (`ILearningMachine<OrchestrationPlanDomain>`) that trains
> `TrainedRouteComposerUnit` to:
> - In Mode 1 (LearnedFlowGrounding): produce FLOW-specific plan structure learned from Mode 1 corpus pairs — this IS ML learning (not deterministic retrieval)
> - In Mode 2 (Generalization): produce a well-structured plan consistent with the FLOW style seen in training — this IS ML learning
> - In Mode 3 (HumanOrchestrationExplanation): produce a human-readable orchestration explanation from attached files — this IS ML learning
>
> `GetOrchestratorAsync()` returns `OperationResult<ILogicalOrchestrator>` —
> `OrchestrationPlanOrchestrator` wrapping `new TaskOrchestrationUnit(routeComposer: trainedUnit)`.
>

> ## HumanIntentBoundaryClassifier (HumanIntentBoundaryClassifier.cs)
>
> `HumanIntentBoundaryClassifier.Classify(string prompt) → IntentBoundaryContract`
>
> **NON-TRAINABLE POLICY GUARD — not a trainable ML unit.**
> This classifier is fully rule-based (keyword patterns + boundary resolution). It is a safety/policy boundary layer, not a machine learning component.
>
> - Its accuracy metrics (`humanIntentAccuracy`, `scopeBoundaryAccuracy`, `forbiddenScopeViolationRate`, `phaseOnlyCompliance`, `approvalGateCompliance`, `artifactNoiseResistance`) are **policy compliance metrics**, not ML training accuracy.
> - It does NOT improve through `TrainOrchestrationBatchAsync`. It cannot be exported or imported as trained weights.
> - If a learned intent router is ever needed, it must be a separate `ILearningMachine<IntentBoundaryDomain>` with its own export/import/manifest/tests and explicit trainable unit designation.
> - In this phase: the policy rules are the ground truth for correct boundary extraction. If a rule is wrong, the rule is fixed in code — not trained away.
>
> **Runs FIRST before any FLOW detection.** Never throws; always returns a contract.
>
> ### Phase 1: Extract MachineArtifacts (passive scan — uses FlowReferenceDetector.DetectAll())
> - **FlowRefs**: call `FlowReferenceDetector.DetectAll(prompt)` → `FlowDetectionResult` — shared implementation, not separate regex
>   (this ensures `1-st flow`, `33*`, `31-functionality` are all caught consistently)
> - **ForbiddenCandidates**: use `detectionResult.ForbiddenCandidates` — bare numbers near forbidden keywords
> - PhaseRefs: `phase \d+(\.\d+)?`, `этап \d+`
> - FileNames: `\S+\.(md|zip|json|pdf|cs)` patterns
> - FactoryIds: `SKILLS_FACTORY_\w+`, `_RAG_\w+`, `v\d+\s+E\d+D`
>
> ### Phase 2: Extract HumanConstraints (keyword scan, case-insensitive, RU+EN)
> - `ForbiddenFlow`: "not now", "не сейчас", "later", "позже", "skip", "пропусти" near a FlowRef
>   **OR** near a bare number from `ForbiddenCandidates` (e.g. `34 will be at later stages, not now` → FLOW-34)
> - `PhaseOnly`: "only", "только", "phase X only", "phase X-Y only"
> - `DoNotProceedUntilApproval`: "do not proceed until", "wait for approval", "не идём дальше"
>   — semantics: plan IS generated + stop boundary; output includes PLAN_ONLY marker;
>     `approvalGateCompliance` = 1.0 means execution beyond approved phase NEVER appears in output
> - `SaveStateRequired`: "save state", "сохрани состояние", "download", "скачай"
> - `DownloadableArtifactRequired`: "zip after", "download after each", "скачать результаты"
> - `DoNotResetExistingFiles`: "do not reset", "не сбрасывай", "не трогай файлы"
> - `IgnoreAttachedFilesAsNoise`: "ignore attachments", "игнорируй вложения"
> - `UseAttachedFilesAsContext`: file bundle names present but no "ignore" keyword
>
> ### Phase 3: Resolve priority (HumanBoundaryResolver)
> - Human explicit constraint > machine artifact name > inferred retrieval
> - If `ForbiddenFlow` constraint contains FLOW-34 AND `MachineFlowRefs` contains FLOW-34 →
>   `ForbiddenFlowScope = [FLOW-34]` (human wins)
> - `AllowedFlowScope = MachineFlowRefs minus ForbiddenFlowScope` (filtered)
>
> ### Phase 4: Classify IntentKind
> - `HumanOrchestrationExplanation`: ONLY when explicit explanation keywords present:
>   "по человечески", "объясни", "разобрать", "как анализировал",
>   "перевести план на человеческий язык", "опиши что делает".
>   ⚠ Attachments alone (`UseAttachedFilesAsContext` without explanation keywords) do NOT trigger Mode 3.
>   Prompt `31-* documents attached` → `UseAttachedFilesAsContext` constraint set, but intent = KnownFlowPlanning
>   (if FlowRef 31 found) or `ImplementationExecutionRequest` (no FlowRef). Never Mode 3 without keywords.
>   ⚠ There is no PromptFlowIndex; the secondary routing trigger has been removed.
>   Mode 3 requires explicit explanation keywords — no index lookup.
> - `SkillLoadSessionInit`: "load skills", "загрузи скилл", "please load", skill file patterns
> - `PhaseContinuation`: `PhaseOnly` constraint present AND planning keywords. Patterns:
>   - Completed range + target: `phase 1-2.4 are done/finished/ready, proceed/start 2.5 only`
>   - Sequential: `finished phase N, start phase N+1`
>   - Sub-phase: `phase 9 to 4-5 sub-phases`, `phase X to sub-phases Y-Z`
>   - `PhaseScope` = the TARGET phase(s) only (NOT the completed range)
>   - `ForbiddenFlowScope` may include phases listed as "done" (guard against reprocessing)
> - `DocumentationMigration`: "translate", "migrate", "adapt", "перевести" near FLOW or technology names
> - `KnownFlowPlanning`: `AllowedFlowScope` non-empty AND no PhaseOnly AND no explanation keywords
> - `ImplementationExecutionRequest`: imperative "start", "run", "execute", "implement" without FLOW
> - `ArchitectureReview`, `TestingPlan`: respective keywords; fallback to `Mode 2` route
> - Default: `KnownFlowPlanning` if FLOW ref found; `ImplementationExecutionRequest` otherwise
>
> ---
>
> ## FlowReferenceDetector (FlowReferenceDetector.cs)
>
> `FlowReferenceDetector.Detect(string prompt) → string? flowRef` — first non-forbidden FLOW ref or null.
> `FlowReferenceDetector.DetectAll(string prompt) → FlowDetectionResult` — ALL refs + ForbiddenCandidates.
> `HumanIntentBoundaryClassifier.Classify(string prompt) → IntentBoundaryContract` (see above section).
> **Visibility**: `Detect`, `DetectAll`, and `Classify` are `internal` (not `public`); raw return types do not
> leak through the public API. The test project accesses them via
> `[assembly: InternalsVisibleTo("LlmFromScratch.Tests")]` in `42.ProjectWikiDomain`.
> Only `GeneratePlanAsync`, `TrainOrchestrationBatchAsync`, and `EvaluateDetailedAsync` are `public`.
>
> Both normalize prompt to uppercase, then apply patterns:
> 1. `FLOW-\d{2}` → canonical `FLOW-NN` (exact)
> 2. `FLOW\s*-?\s*(\d{2})` → normalize to `FLOW-NN` (e.g. `FLOW33`, `flow 33`, `flow-33`)
> 3. `\b(\d{2})\*` → bare number prefix like `33*` or `31-*` → `FLOW-NN`
> 4. `\b(\d{2})-` → file-name prefix like `31-functionality` → `FLOW-NN`
> 5. Ordinal words: `first`→01, `second`→02, `third`→03, … (up to 10th) → `FLOW-NN`
> 6. `(?:the\s+)?(\d{1,2})\s*-?\s*(?:st|nd|rd|th)\s+flow` → `FLOW-NN`
>    (optional hyphen/space between digit and suffix catches both `1st flow` and `1-st flow`)
> 7. **Forbidden-context bare number**: `\b(\d{1,2})\b` adjacent to forbidden keywords
>    (`not now`, `later`, `не сейчас`, `позже`, `skip`) within 10 tokens → normalized to
>    `FLOW-NN` and placed in `FlowDetectionResult.ForbiddenCandidates` (used by classifier Phase 2)
>
> `Detect()` returns first non-forbidden match or null.
> `DetectAll()` returns `FlowDetectionResult` with `AllRefs` (all found) and `ForbiddenCandidates` (forbidden-context hits).
>
> Detector tests (detector(3) category in commit, = tests 7-9 in table):
> - Test 7 `OrchestrationMachine_Mode1_RecognizesFlow33WithoutHyphen` → exercises `DetectsFlowWithSpace` pattern
> - Test 8 `OrchestrationMachine_Mode1_RecognizesFlow31FromDocumentPrefix` → exercises `DetectsFilenamePrefix31` pattern
> - Test 9 `OrchestrationMachine_Mode1_RecognizesFirstFlowOrdinal` → exercises `DetectsFirstFlowOrdinal` pattern
> The additional three patterns (`DetectsExplicitHyphen`, `DetectsBareStar33`, `ReturnsNullForGenericPrompt`) are also
> covered by the same integration test suite via corpus builder pair generation. No separate count — total remains 36.
>
> ---
>
> ## PromptFlowGroundingModel (named trainable component within OrchestrationPlanMachine)
>
> **Definition:** `PromptFlowGroundingModel` is the named trainable component responsible for Mode 1 (LearnedFlowGrounding). It is NOT a standalone `ILearningMachine` — it is a named, well-specified subcomponent of `OrchestrationPlanMachine` with its own trained state, checkpoint section, and provable generalization gates.
>
> **What it replaces:** The banned deterministic path: `FlowReferenceDetector → _flowIndex.TryGetValue → canonical plan`. The FLOW docs that were in `_flowIndex` become Mode 1 training data fed through corpus builder.
>
> **Trained state (included in checkpoint section 1-2):**
> ```csharp
> private readonly OrchestrationKnnStore _flowGroundingKnn = new();      // Mode 1 KNN store
> private readonly Dictionary<string, OrchestrationFlowGroundingWeights> _flowGroundingWeights = new();  // Mode 1 weights
> ```
>
> **Training contract:**
> - Input: `OrchestrationTrainingPair` with `PairMode.Mode1LearnedFlowGrounding`
>   - `Prompt`: accepted FLOW-specific prompt (e.g. "start from FLOW-33, read 33* files carefully")
>   - `PlanChosen`: canonical `OrchestrationPlanChosen` for that FLOW (from FLOW doc, parsed by corpus builder)
>   - `FlowRef`: "FLOW-33" (label added by corpus builder via `FlowReferenceDetector.DetectAll` at build time)
> - Processing: tokenize Prompt + FlowRef hint → update `_flowGroundingKnn` + `_flowGroundingWeights`
> - No production `FlowReferenceDetector` call; FlowRef comes from the corpus pair's `ExpectedBoundary.AllowedFlowScope`
>
> **Inference contract (in `GeneratePlanAsync` Step 4):**
> ```csharp
> if (contract.Kind == IntentKind.KnownFlowPlanning && _flowGroundingKnn.HasEntries)
> {
>     var flowRefHint = contract.AllowedFlowScope.FirstOrDefault(); // from classifier, not from runtime detector
>     var nearest = _flowGroundingKnn.FindNearestWithFlowHint(prompt, flowRefHint);
>     var plan = ApplyFlowGroundingOverlay(nearest, _flowGroundingWeights, prompt, contract);
>     return ... RouteMode=LearnedFlowGrounding, MlGenerated=true ...
> }
> ```
> The `flowRefHint` is passed as a query weight (not a dictionary key); it biases KNN toward training examples labeled with that FlowRef. The machine does NOT look up `_flowIndex[flowRefHint]`.
>
> **Checkpoint section (in `SaveCheckpointAsync` sections 1-2):**
> ```json
> {
>   "flow_grounding_knn": { ... trained KNN entries ... },
>   "flow_grounding_weights": { ... per-FlowRef weights ... }
> }
> ```
> Fresh `LoadCheckpointAsync` on a new process (no corpus dir) restores both sections; Mode 1 LearnedFlowGrounding is immediately functional.
>
> **Provability gates (tests + Gate B):**
> - Test 6: trained machine → "flow 33" → LearnedFlowGrounding, MlGenerated=true, FLOW-33 structure ✓
> - Test 37: export → import (fresh process) → "flow 33" still → FLOW-33 structure (grounding survives checkpoint roundtrip)
> - Test 38: fresh untrained machine → "flow 33" → Mode2Generalization (fallback; no FLOW structure) — ablation ✓
> - Gate B B.7: `mode1FlowGroundingKnnSize > 0`, `fixture_grounding["flow 33"]` → structure present, MlGenerated=true
>
> **Leakage gate (`exactPromptHitRate = 0.0`):**
> Eval must exclude pairs where the eval prompt is an exact text match to a training prompt.
> This proves `_flowGroundingKnn` generalizes (new phrasings of "FLOW-33 request" produce correct structure),
> rather than acting as a lookup memory for exact training prompts.
>
> ---
>
> ## CorpusContaminationAudit (build-time only — NOT a runtime routing component)
>
> **PromptFlowIndex has been REMOVED from `OrchestrationPlanMachine` and from all production routing.**
>
> **Rationale:** An exact-prompt lookup from accepted orchestration prompts is a deterministic shortcut, not ML generalization. A prompt without an explicit FLOW number that happens to appear in an accepted-prompts file must NOT get canonical FLOW retrieval — that hides a lookup as trained inference and produces misleading `mlGenerated=false` failures on prompts the model should generalize.
>
> **Hard rule (Mode 1 routing — LearnedFlowGrounding):**
> ```
> Mode 1 (LearnedFlowGrounding) activates when HumanIntentBoundaryClassifier detects an explicit
> FLOW reference in the prompt (via FlowReferenceDetector in Phase 1) and classifies IntentKind=KnownFlowPlanning.
>
> Mode 1 is ML-generated: the machine uses _flowGroundingKnn + _flowGroundingWeights (trained on Mode 1
> corpus pairs) to produce FLOW-specific plan structure. It does NOT do dictionary lookup.
>
> A prompt WITHOUT an explicit FLOW reference → IntentKind ≠ KnownFlowPlanning → Mode 2 (unseenStyleAccuracy).
> It is the model's job to generalize — no index, no shortcut.
>
> FlowReferenceDetector is ONLY called inside HumanIntentBoundaryClassifier (metadata extraction).
> GeneratePlanAsync never calls FlowReferenceDetector directly.
> ```
>
> **What replaces PromptFlowIndex at build time:**
>
> `CorpusContaminationAudit` (in `OrchestrationCorpusAudit.cs`, called at corpus build time only):
> - Reads accepted/approved/typo orchestration prompt files.
> - For each accepted prompt: strip FLOW refs, normalize text.
> - If normalized text appears verbatim in Mode 2 training prompts → **reject that Mode 2 pair** (contamination: training on exact accepted prompt text creates lookup memory).
> - If normalized text appears in Mode 2 held-out eval prompts → **reject that eval pair** (contamination: eval on exact accepted prompt text gives false accuracy).
> - Outputs `ContaminationReport` with rejected pair IDs and reason codes.
> - Called from `build-orchestration-corpus` CLI — never at runtime.
>
> `OrchestrationCorpusAudit.LoadFlowDocs(sourceDir)` — corpus builder helper (NOT called by machine):
> - Reads 42 FLOW `.md` files and returns a collection of `(FlowRef, OrchestrationPlanChosen)` tuples.
> - Used by `OrchestrationCorpusBuilder` to create Mode 1 training pairs (PairMode.Mode1LearnedFlowGrounding).
> - NEVER called from `OrchestrationPlanMachine` constructor or runtime. FLOW docs = training data, not runtime state.
>
> **Removed from the system entirely:**
> - `PromptFlowIndex` class
> - `BoundarySource.PromptFlowIndex` enum value (only `BoundarySource.Classifier` remains; consider removing enum entirely)
> - `Step 1a` merge block in `GeneratePlanAsync`
> - `_promptFlowIndex` field in `OrchestrationPlanMachine`
> - All tests/gates that assert `boundarySource=PromptFlowIndex` (those become `boundarySource=Classifier`)
>
> ---
>
> ## Contracts (OrchestrationPlanContracts.cs)
>
> ```csharp
> // FlowDetectionResult — typed result from FlowReferenceDetector.DetectAll().
> // AllRefs: all normalized FLOW-NN refs found in prompt.
> // ForbiddenCandidates: bare numbers near forbidden keywords (e.g. "34 not now" → "FLOW-34").
> public sealed record FlowDetectionResult(
>     IReadOnlyList<string> AllRefs,
>     IReadOnlyList<string> ForbiddenCandidates);
>
> // OrchestrationPlanChosen — structured; not raw text.
> public sealed record OrchestrationPlanChosen(
>     string FlowRef,
>     IReadOnlyList<string> PhaseSequence,
>     IReadOnlyList<string> ArtifactNames,
>     IReadOnlyList<string> GateSequence,
>     IReadOnlyList<string> StackRefs,
>     IReadOnlyList<string> TaskTypes,         // may be empty (Format B); scorer handles
>     IReadOnlyList<string> DependencyFlows,
>     string ChosenText);                      // serialized plan text from above
>
> public enum PairMode { Mode1LearnedFlowGrounding, Mode2Generalization, Mode3HumanExplanation }
>
> public enum ExpectedIntent { PlanNewFlow, ExplainAttachedFiles, DescribeAnalysisProcess }
>
> // OrchestrationHumanExplanationChosen — structured human-explanation output.
> public sealed record OrchestrationHumanExplanationChosen(
>     string ProblemStatement,                 // "какой запрос/проблема решается"
>     IReadOnlyList<string> FunctionalitySteps, // "постепенное описание функционала"
>     IReadOnlyList<string> DesignDecisions,   // "техническое дизайн-решение"
>     IReadOnlyList<string> ImplementationPhases, // "этапы реализации"
>     string? AnalysisTrace,                   // "как я анализировал файлы" (may be null)
>     string FlowRef,                          // FLOW-NN or ADAPTER-NN inferred from attached files
>     string ChosenText);                      // full human-readable explanation text
>
> // OrchestrationTrainingPair — unified DPO pair for all three modes; corpus JSONL format AND training batch item.
> // PlanChosen is non-null for Mode 1 + Mode 2; HumanExplanationChosen is non-null for Mode 3.
> // ExpectedBoundary carries the ground-truth IntentBoundaryContract extracted at corpus-build time
> // (AllowedFlowScope, ForbiddenFlowScope, PhaseScope, RequiresApprovalGate, etc.) — used in compliance scoring.
> // AttachedFileNames and ConversationContext are non-null for Mode 3 grok session pairs.
> public sealed record OrchestrationTrainingPair(
>     string PairId,
>     string FlowRef,
>     string Prompt,
>     PairMode Mode,
>     IntentBoundaryContract ExpectedBoundary,           // ground-truth AllowedFlowScope, ForbiddenFlowScope, PhaseScope
>     OrchestrationPlanChosen? PlanChosen,               // non-null for Mode 1 + Mode 2
>     OrchestrationHumanExplanationChosen? HumanExplanationChosen, // non-null for Mode 3
>     IReadOnlyList<string>? AttachedFileNames,          // non-null for Mode 3 (from grok sessions)
>     string? ConversationContext,                        // non-null for DescribeAnalysisProcess
>     ExpectedIntent? HumanIntent,                       // non-null for Mode 3 (ExplainAttachedFiles / DescribeAnalysisProcess)
>     string RejectedText,
>     string RejectedType);
>
> // OrchestrationTrainingBatch — batch of training pairs passed to TrainOrchestrationBatchAsync.
> public sealed record OrchestrationTrainingBatch(
>     IReadOnlyList<OrchestrationTrainingPair> Pairs,
>     string BatchId);
>
> // IntentBoundaryContract — output of HumanIntentBoundaryClassifier.
> public sealed record IntentBoundaryContract(
>     IntentKind Kind,
>     IReadOnlyList<HumanConstraintType> HumanConstraints,
>     IReadOnlyList<string> AllowedFlowScope,     // empty = all allowed
>     IReadOnlyList<string> ForbiddenFlowScope,   // must never appear in output
>     IReadOnlyList<string> PhaseScope,           // non-empty = PhaseOnly constraint
>     IReadOnlyList<string> MachineFlowRefs,      // raw machine artifacts found in prompt
>     IReadOnlyList<string> MachineFileNames,     // attached file names
>     bool RequiresApprovalGate,                  // DoNotProceedUntilApproval
>     bool RequiresSaveState,                     // SaveStateRequired
>     bool RequiresDownloadableArtifact);         // DownloadableArtifactRequired
>
> public enum IntentKind
> {
>     KnownFlowPlanning, PhaseContinuation, DocumentationMigration,
>     HumanOrchestrationExplanation, SkillLoadSessionInit,
>     ArchitectureReview, TestingPlan, ImplementationExecutionRequest
> }
>
> public enum HumanConstraintType
> {
>     OnlyFlow, ForbiddenFlow, PhaseOnly, DoNotProceedUntilApproval,
>     SaveStateRequired, DownloadableArtifactRequired, DoNotResetExistingFiles,
>     UseAttachedFilesAsContext, IgnoreAttachedFilesAsNoise
> }
>
> // OrchestrationCheckpointCache — file-stamp key (same pattern as TranslationCheckpointCache).
> // Stores OrchestrationMachineLoadResult (not just Machine) so cursor is restored on cache hit.
> public sealed class OrchestrationCheckpointCache { ... }   // TryGet, Store, Invalidate
>
> // OrchestrationFlowGroundingWeights — per-token learned weights for Mode 1 LearnedFlowGrounding.
> // Trained on Mode 1 corpus pairs (FLOW-specific prompts + canonical plan chosen responses).
> // Encodes FLOW-specific structural patterns learned from canonical FLOW docs used as training data.
> public sealed record OrchestrationFlowGroundingWeights(
>     IReadOnlyDictionary<string, float> FlowRefWeights,       // which FlowRefs are associated with which prompts
>     IReadOnlyDictionary<string, float> PhaseWeights,         // FLOW-specific phase structure
>     IReadOnlyDictionary<string, float> ArtifactWeights,
>     IReadOnlyDictionary<string, float> GateWeights,
>     IReadOnlyDictionary<string, float> StackWeights);
>
> // OrchestrationStructureWeights — per-token learned weights for Mode 2 generalization.

>     IReadOnlyDictionary<string, float> ArtifactWeights,
>     IReadOnlyDictionary<string, float> GateWeights,
>     IReadOnlyDictionary<string, float> StackWeights);
>
> // OrchestrationHumanExplanationWeights — per-token learned weights for Mode 3 explanation structure.
> // Trained alongside _humanExplanationKnn in TrainBatchAsync; both saved in checkpoint.
> public sealed record OrchestrationHumanExplanationWeights(
>     IReadOnlyDictionary<string, float> ProblemStatementWeights,
>     IReadOnlyDictionary<string, float> FunctionalityStepWeights,
>     IReadOnlyDictionary<string, float> DesignDecisionWeights,
>     IReadOnlyDictionary<string, float> ImplementationPhaseWeights,
>     IReadOnlyDictionary<string, float> AnalysisTraceWeights);  // may be empty if no AnalysisTrace in corpus
>
> // OrchestrationGenerationResult — output of GeneratePlanAsync; carries routing metadata alongside plan text.
> // BoundarySource: always Classifier (PromptFlowIndex removed). Retained for forward compatibility.
> // MlGenerated=true for ALL three production modes (LearnedFlowGrounding, Mode2Generalization,
> //   Mode3HumanExplanation). Only Passthrough (SkillLoad bypass) has MlGenerated=false.
> // RetrievalSource removed — all routes are ML-generated; the field is gone.
> public sealed record OrchestrationGenerationResult(
>     string PlanText,
>     GenerationRouteMode RouteMode,
>     BoundarySource BoundarySource,          // always Classifier
>     bool MlGenerated,                       // true for all three trained modes; false only for Passthrough
>     IntentKind IntentKind,
>     IReadOnlyList<string> Warnings);        // e.g. ["PLAN_ONLY_PENDING_APPROVAL"]
>
> public enum GenerationRouteMode
> {
>     LearnedFlowGrounding,    // Mode 1 — trained KNN+FlowGroundingWeights (replaces KnownFlowRetrieval)
>     Mode2Generalization,     // Mode 2 — trained KNN+PatternMap for non-FLOW-specific prompts
>     Mode3HumanExplanation,   // Mode 3 — trained KNN+HumanExplanationWeights
>     Passthrough              // SkillLoad bypass — no generation
> }
> public enum BoundarySource { Classifier }   // only Classifier (PromptFlowIndex removed)
> // RetrievalSource enum REMOVED — no production route has a retrieval source; all are ML-generated.
>
> // OrchestrationLoopCheckpoint — persisted runner state; restored on --require-checkpoint-resume.
> // TrainedPairIds: ALL PairIds ever passed to TrainOrchestrationBatchAsync (regardless of promotion decision).
> //   Used on resume to exclude already-trained pairs from candidate selection — prevents double-training.
> //   Must be non-empty after the first training cycle (same invariant as TranslationMachine AcceptedTrainingRows bug).
> // Mode2PromotedPairIds / Mode3PromotedPairIds: subsets where the per-mode promotion criterion was met.
> //   Used for reporting and promotion metrics; may be empty if promotion gate has not yet been reached.
> public sealed record OrchestrationLoopCheckpoint(
>     string PrivatePairsPath,
>     int LastCompletedCycle,
>     int Cursor,
>     IReadOnlyList<string> TrainedPairIds,            // ALL pair IDs passed to TrainOrchestrationBatchAsync (exclusion list)
>     IReadOnlyList<string> Mode2PromotedPairIds,      // Mode 2 pairs where promotionDecision=PROMOTE (non-empty after first Mode 2 promotion)
>     IReadOnlyList<string> Mode3PromotedPairIds);     // Mode 3 pairs where humanExplanationAccuracy >= ExplanationTarget (may be [] if not yet reached)
>
> // OrchestrationMachineLoadResult — same pattern as TranslationMachineLoadResult.
> public sealed record OrchestrationMachineLoadResult(

> ## Step 0 — Corpus audit (OrchestrationCorpusAudit.cs)
>
> Read-only. Two audit sweeps:
>
> **Sweep A — FLOW docs** (for Mode 1 + Mode 2):
> For each `.md` in `claude-sessions/claude orchestrator/`:
> 1. Detect format A ("Что мы строим") or B ("ЗАЧЕМ") or UNKNOWN
> 2. Extract format-aware: PhaseSequence, ArtifactNames, GateLabels, StackRefs, TaskTypes, DependencyFlows
> 3. `TrainingReady = PhaseSequence>=2 AND ArtifactNames>=1 AND GateLabels>=1 AND StackRefs>=1`
>
> **Sweep B — Grok explanation sessions** (for Mode 3):
> Scan `claude-sessions\grok  orchestrator\` directly (TWO spaces in folder name; NOT through _workset.csv):
> 1. Detect if session contains an attached-file explanation prompt ("по человечески", "объясни", "разобрать", "как ты анализировал", OR attached file names in message)
> 2. Extract: AttachedFileNames, inferred FlowRef (from file name prefix like `33-`, `31-`), ExpectedIntent
> 3. `ExplanationReady = AttachedFileNames>=1 AND ChosenAnswer non-empty`
>
> Output `orchestration-corpus-audit.json` with both sweeps.
>
> **Audit gates**:
> - `TrainingReadyCount >= 20` (FLOW docs)
> - `ExplanationReadyCount >= 10` (grok sessions; fail-fast only if < 5)
>
> CLI: `audit-orchestration-corpus --source-dir <path> --output <audit.json>`
>
> ---
>
> ## Step 1 — Corpus builder (OrchestrationCorpusBuilder.cs)
>
> ### Group split (contamination prevention)
> ```
> Training FLOW set:  TrainingReady FLOWs sorted by number → first 70%
> Held-out FLOW set:  last 30% — never in train batches, never in Mode 2 training
> ```
>
> FlowIndex contains ALL FLOWs (not just training ones). The split only governs
> Mode 2 generalization training. Mode 1 retrieval uses FlowIndex for all 42 FLOWs.
>
> ### Pair mode tagging
>
> **Mode 1 pairs** (PairMode.Mode1Retrieval):
> - Prompt: (a) any form of FLOW reference detected by `FlowReferenceDetector` (e.g. `flow 33`,
>   `33* files`, `31-* documents`, `1-st flow`, `FLOW-01`) OR (b) comes from a workset session
>   whose name contains a FLOW number
>   ⚠ (c) "matches PromptFlowIndex" REMOVED — no known-prompt secondary trigger in Mode 1
> - One canonical prompt per FLOW using the actual accepted prompt from private prompt files
>   where available; synthetic `"start development from FLOW-NN"` otherwise
> - Chosen: canonical OrchestrationPlanChosen from that exact FLOW doc
> - These pairs test retrieval accuracy; they are NOT used in ML PatternMap training
> - Built from ALL 42 FLOWs (both training and held-out sets)
>
> **Mode 2 pairs** (PairMode.Mode2Generalization):
> - Prompt: synthetic (first sentence of "Что мы строим"/"ЗАЧЕМ" section, with FLOW-NN stripped out)
>   OR from accepted prompts file (after removing ALL FLOW-NN references including bare numbers)
> - Chosen: OrchestrationPlanChosen from training FLOWs only
> - Built only from 70% training FLOW set (→ `Mode2TrainingPairs`)
> - 30% held-out FLOW set generates `Mode2HeldOutEvalPairs` — used for evaluation only, never trained
>
> ### 8 rejection types (OC-A through OC-H) for Mode 2 pairs only
>
> | Code | RejectedType | How to build |
> |------|-------------|-------------|
> | OC-A | `generic_template` | Real Bootstrap output: `new TaskOrchestrationUnit().OrchestrateAsync(new SubmitUserTaskRequest(UserPrompt=prompt, ActiveProjectRoot=Path.GetTempPath(), LinkedProjectRoots=[], UserFacingEntrypoint="test"), ct)` |
> | OC-B | `wrong_stack` | Replace StackRefs with wrong stack |
> | OC-C | `no_phase_breakdown` | Omit PhaseSequence |
> | OC-D | `wrong_phase_count` | Keep first half of phases only |
> | OC-E | `missing_artifacts` | Omit ArtifactNames |
> | OC-F | `no_gate_sequence` | Omit GateSequence |
> | OC-G | `missing_dependencies` | Omit DependencyFlows; if empty, omit StackRefs |
> | OC-H | `wrong_task_types` | Replace TaskTypes from a different TrainingReady FLOW |
>
> Mode 1 (Mode1LearnedFlowGrounding) pairs use only OC-A (generic_template) as rejected (untrained machine → Bootstrap output, no FLOW structure).
>
> ### Mode 3 rejection types (OE-A through OE-J)
>
> | Code | RejectedType | How to build |
> |------|-------------|-------------|
> | OE-A | `canonical_dump_instead_of_human` | SerializeChosen of canonical FLOW plan (machine jargon) |
> | OE-B | `generic_template` | Real Bootstrap output (same as OC-A) |
> | OE-C | `wrong_flow_from_attachment` | Explanation from wrong FLOW doc |
> | OE-D | `ignored_attached_files` | Explanation ignoring AttachedFileNames completely |
> | OE-E | `machine_jargon_overload` | Chosen text + inject task IDs T-NNN, schema version numbers |
> | OE-F | `missing_problem_statement` | Omit ProblemStatement |
> | OE-G | `missing_stepwise_functionality` | Omit FunctionalitySteps |
> | OE-H | `missing_design_decisions` | Omit DesignDecisions |
> | OE-I | `missing_implementation_phases` | Omit ImplementationPhases |
> | OE-J | `answered_next_action_instead` | Replace chosen text with "Next step: …" action list |
>
> **Corpus gates**:
> - `Mode1Pairs >= 42` (one per FLOW doc; all 42 FLOWs; routing quality test only)
> - `Mode2TrainingPairs >= 200` (from 70% training FLOW set; ML training)
> - `Mode2HeldOutEvalPairs >= 40` (from 30% held-out FLOW set; evaluation only, never trained)
> - `NoFlowRefOverlap = true` (Mode 2 training prompts contain no FLOW-NN refs and no bare flow numbers)
> - `Mode3TrainingPairs >= 30` (from grok orchestrator session files; ML training for Mode 3)
> - `Mode3HeldOutEvalPairs >= 20` (from grok sessions; held-out only, never trained; used by EvaluateDetailedAsync)
> - `NoMode3SourceBundleOverlap = true` (same attached file bundle/set must not appear in BOTH Mode3Training and Mode3HeldOut)
> - `NoMode3FlowRefOverlap = true` (same inferred FlowRef must not appear in BOTH Mode3Training and Mode3HeldOut)
>   Note: generic prompt text overlap (e.g. "по человечески описана оркестрация" as template) is acceptable —
>   leakage is defined by AttachedFileNames and FlowRef overlap, NOT prompt text similarity.
>   Split strategy (FlowRef-group split — NOT row split):
>     1. Collect all unique inferred FlowRefs from grok sessions.
>     2. Sort FlowRef groups deterministically (e.g. alphabetically).
>     3. Assign first 60% of FlowRef groups → all their sessions go to Mode3TrainingPairs.
>     4. Assign last 40% of FlowRef groups → all their sessions go to Mode3HeldOutEvalPairs.
>     NoMode3FlowRefOverlap is guaranteed because each FlowRef lands entirely in one partition.
>     Row-level splitting (sort all rows by FlowRef then take first 60%) would cut a FlowRef across partitions → forbidden.
>   Legacy field `Mode3ExplanationPairs` = Mode3TrainingPairs + Mode3HeldOutEvalPairs (total grok pairs; >= 50 required).
>
> CLI: `build-orchestration-corpus --source-dir <path> --audit <audit.json> --output <corpus.jsonl> [--pairs-per-flow 8]`
>
> ---
>
> ## Step 2 — OrchestrationPlanMachine (OrchestrationPlanMachine.cs)
>
> ### Internal state
>
> ```csharp
> // ALL internal state is trained ML state — no deterministic indices or dictionaries.
> // Canonical FLOW docs are training data (input to corpus builder); not loaded at construction.
>
> // Mode 1 (LearnedFlowGrounding) trained state:
> // Learns FLOW-specific plan structure from Mode 1 corpus pairs.
> // Fresh untrained machine → "flow 33" → generic output.
> // Trained machine → "flow 33" → FLOW-33-specific structure (phase labels, artifact names, etc.)
> private readonly OrchestrationKnnStore _flowGroundingKnn = new();
> private readonly Dictionary<string, OrchestrationFlowGroundingWeights> _flowGroundingWeights = new();
>
> // Mode 2 (Generalization) trained state:
> private readonly OrchestrationKnnStore _knn = new();
> private readonly Dictionary<string, OrchestrationStructureWeights> _patternMap = new();
>
> // Mode 3 (HumanOrchestrationExplanation) trained state:
> private readonly OrchestrationKnnStore _humanExplanationKnn = new();
> private readonly Dictionary<string, OrchestrationHumanExplanationWeights> _humanExplanationPatternMap = new();
>
> // NOTE: _flowIndex REMOVED — no runtime dictionary lookup by FlowRef.
> // NOTE: PromptFlowIndex REMOVED — no known-prompt index.
> // FlowReferenceDetector used ONLY in HumanIntentBoundaryClassifier (metadata extraction),
> // NOT in GeneratePlanAsync routing.
> ```
>
> ### TrainOrchestrationBatchAsync (domain method) + TrainBatchAsync (ILearningMachine adapter)
>
> `TrainOrchestrationBatchAsync(OrchestrationTrainingBatch batch, CancellationToken ct)` — **primary domain method**.
> Runner reads corpus JSONL → deserializes `OrchestrationTrainingPair[]` → wraps in `OrchestrationTrainingBatch` → passes to this method.
>
> `TrainBatchAsync(LearningBatch<OrchestrationPlanDomain> batch, ct)` — **ILearningMachine interface adapter only**.
> Adapter format: `LearningBatch<OrchestrationPlanDomain>` carries `TrainingItems: IReadOnlyList<LearningTrainingItem>`
> where each `LearningTrainingItem` maps to `OrchestrationTrainingPair` as follows:
> - `LearningTrainingItem.ItemId = pair.PairId`
> - `LearningTrainingItem.Prompt = pair.Prompt`
> - `LearningTrainingItem.ChosenResponse = JsonSerializer.Serialize(pair)`  (full pair JSON — adapter deserializes on receive)
> - `LearningTrainingItem.RejectedResponse = pair.RejectedText`
> Adapter deserializes each `ChosenResponse` via `JsonSerializer.Deserialize<OrchestrationTrainingPair>`,
> collects into `OrchestrationTrainingBatch`, and delegates to `TrainOrchestrationBatchAsync`. Never called directly by runner.
>
> Each `OrchestrationTrainingPair` already carries `PairMode`, `ExpectedBoundary` (AllowedFlowScope, ForbiddenFlowScope, PhaseScope), `PlanChosen?`, `HumanExplanationChosen?`. No mode inference needed at train time.
>
> Routing by mode — ALL three modes produce trained ML weights (no mode skips):
> - `Mode1LearnedFlowGrounding` → tokenize Prompt (+ AllowedFlowScope hint) → update `_flowGroundingWeights` using `PlanChosen`; store in `_flowGroundingKnn`. Canonical FLOW doc content is the chosen response — training data, not a runtime index.
> - `Mode2Generalization` → tokenize Prompt → update `_patternMap` weights using `PlanChosen`; store in `_knn`
> - `Mode3HumanExplanation` → tokenize Prompt + AttachedFileNames + ConversationContext → update `_humanExplanationPatternMap`; store in `_humanExplanationKnn`
>
> **Mode 1 is now trainable ML**, not deterministic source-authority. Fresh untrained machine cannot correctly route "flow 33" to FLOW-33 structure. After training on Mode 1 pairs, it can. After export/import, it still can.
>
> `RenderHumanExplanation(nearest, _humanExplanationPatternMap, contract, prompt)` applies patternMap section weights on top of KNN result — this is the trained inference step, NOT a lookup passthrough.
>
> ### EvaluateAsync — three-tier metrics
>
> **Tier 1 — Mode 1 LearnedFlowGrounding accuracy** (pairs where Mode=Mode1LearnedFlowGrounding):
> - Call `GeneratePlanAsync(prompt)` → must route to `LearnedFlowGrounding` path
> - Score: 5 structural metrics (same as Mode 2): phaseCountAccuracy, artifactRecall, gateSequenceAccuracy, stackRefAccuracy, taskTypeRecall
> - `learnedFlowGroundingAccuracy = mean structural accuracy across Mode 1 held-out pairs`
> - ⚠ This IS an ML accuracy metric — it counts toward `overallTrainingAccuracy`
> - ⚠ Mode 1 eval pairs MUST have `MlGenerated=true AND RouteMode=LearnedFlowGrounding`
> - exactPromptHitRate check: if eval prompt is exact text match to a Mode 1 training prompt → EXCLUDE from accuracy (lookup memory, not generalization). `exactPromptHitRate` metric must be 0.0 in eval.
>
> **Tier 2 — Mode 2 Generalization accuracy** (pairs where Mode=Mode2Generalization):
> - Score: 5 FLOW-specific structural metrics
> - `taskTypeRecall` skipped when expected count = 0 (not counted in mean)
> - `phaseCountAccuracy` clamped to [0,1]
> - `unseenStyleAccuracy = mean productAccuracy across Mode 2 held-out pairs`
> - exactPromptHitRate check: exact training prompt matches excluded from eval; `exactPromptHitRate` must = 0.0
> - ⚠ Mode 2 eval pairs MUST have `boundarySource=Classifier AND MlGenerated=true AND RouteMode=Mode2Generalization`
> - `overallTrainingAccuracy = mean(learnedFlowGroundingAccuracy, unseenStyleAccuracy)` (Modes 1 + 2)
>
> **Tier 3 — Mode 3 explanation accuracy** (pairs where Mode=Mode3HumanExplanation):
> - Score: 4 metrics: `problemStatementPresent`, `functionalityStepsCount >= 2`, `implementationPhasesCount >= 1`,
>   `unexplainedMachineJargonRate < 0.15` (technical terms like BFA/SESSION/T47/DPO are allowed IF followed by human explanation; metric = fraction of unexplained technical terms per token count)
> - `humanExplanationAccuracy = mean across Mode 3 test pairs`
>
> **Tier 4 — Boundary compliance metrics** (all pairs; constraint extracted by classifier):
> - `humanIntentAccuracy` = fraction of pairs where classifier routed to correct `IntentKind`
> - `scopeBoundaryAccuracy` = fraction where `AllowedFlowScope` + `ForbiddenFlowScope` match ground truth
> - `forbiddenScopeViolationRate` = fraction where output includes forbidden FLOW/phase (**hard gate: must = 0.0**)
> - `phaseOnlyCompliance` = fraction where PhaseOnly constraint respected (**hard gate: must = 1.0**)
> - `approvalGateCompliance` = fraction where DoNotProceedUntilApproval constraint respected (**hard gate: must = 1.0**)
> - `artifactNoiseResistance` = fraction where machine artifact names did not override human constraints
>
> **ILearningMachine.EvaluateAsync**: Returns `LearningEvaluationResult` with
> `Accuracy = overallTrainingAccuracy = unseenStyleAccuracy` (Mode 2 only). Interface contract met.
>
> **EvaluateDetailedAsync** (domain-specific, called by runner): Returns `OrchestrationEvaluationReport`
> with all 11 fields including the three hard-gate compliance values.
>
> `PassesGate = learnedFlowGroundingAccuracy >= FlowGroundingTarget        // Mode 1 ML accuracy gate
>            AND unseenStyleAccuracy >= StyleTarget                          // Mode 2 ML accuracy gate
>            AND humanExplanationAccuracy >= ExplanationTarget               // Mode 3 ML accuracy gate
>            AND exactPromptHitRate = 0.0                                   // hard: no exact-prompt memory lookup in eval
>            AND forbiddenScopeViolationRate = 0.0
>            AND phaseOnlyCompliance = 1.0
>            AND approvalGateCompliance = 1.0`
>
> ### GeneratePlanAsync(prompt) → OperationResult\<OrchestrationGenerationResult\> (boundary layer + three-mode dispatcher)
>
> ```csharp
> // Step 1: MANDATORY — classify intent and extract constraints BEFORE anything else.
> // HumanIntentBoundaryClassifier is the ONLY boundary source; PromptFlowIndex has been removed.
> // BoundarySource is always Classifier; the enum/field may be removed in a future simplification.
> var contract = HumanIntentBoundaryClassifier.Classify(prompt);
> var warnings = new List<string>();
> // (No Step 1a: PromptFlowIndex merge removed. No secondary index lookup at runtime.)
>
> // Step 2: Hard-gate SkillLoad — return passthrough, no plan generation
> // OrchestrationGenerationResult constructor order: PlanText, RouteMode, BoundarySource, RetrievalSource, MlGenerated, IntentKind, Warnings
> if (contract.Kind == IntentKind.SkillLoadSessionInit)
>     return OperationResult<OrchestrationGenerationResult>.Ok(
>         new OrchestrationGenerationResult("", GenerationRouteMode.Passthrough,
>             BoundarySource.Classifier, MlGenerated: false, contract.Kind, []));
>
> // Step 2a: ApprovalGate constraint — plan IS generated but tagged PLAN_ONLY; no execution boundary
> // (DoNotProceedUntilApproval ≠ no plan; it means: plan allowed, execution past this step forbidden)
> if (contract.RequiresApprovalGate) warnings.Add("PLAN_ONLY_PENDING_APPROVAL");
>
> // Step 3: Human explanation path (Mode 3) — uses both _humanExplanationKnn and _humanExplanationPatternMap.
> // Triggered ONLY by explanation keywords in prompt (no PromptFlowIndex lookup).
> // RetrievalSource=None; BoundarySource=Classifier (always — PromptFlowIndex removed).
> if (contract.Kind == IntentKind.HumanOrchestrationExplanation)
> {
>     var nearestExplanation = _humanExplanationKnn.FindNearest(prompt);
>     var explanationText = RenderHumanExplanation(nearestExplanation, _humanExplanationPatternMap, contract, prompt);
>     return OperationResult<OrchestrationGenerationResult>.Ok(
>         new OrchestrationGenerationResult(explanationText, GenerationRouteMode.Mode3HumanExplanation,
>             BoundarySource.Classifier, MlGenerated: true, contract.Kind, warnings));
> }
>
> // Step 4: Mode 1 — LearnedFlowGrounding (ML; NOT a dictionary lookup).
> // Uses _flowGroundingKnn + _flowGroundingWeights trained on Mode 1 corpus pairs.
> // FlowRef from contract.AllowedFlowScope is passed as a QUERY HINT to the KNN (weighted toward
> // training examples with matching FlowRef), not as a dictionary key.
> // Fresh untrained machine → "flow 33" → generic/weak output.
> // Trained machine → "flow 33" → FLOW-33-specific structure (phase labels, gates, artifacts).
> // MlGenerated=true for Mode 1: this is learned behavior, not source-authority retrieval.
> if (contract.Kind == IntentKind.KnownFlowPlanning && _flowGroundingKnn.HasEntries)
> {
>     var flowRef = contract.AllowedFlowScope.FirstOrDefault();
>     var nearestGrounding = _flowGroundingKnn.FindNearestWithFlowHint(prompt, flowRef);
>     var groundedPlan = ApplyFlowGroundingOverlay(nearestGrounding, _flowGroundingWeights, prompt, contract);
>     return OperationResult<OrchestrationGenerationResult>.Ok(
>         new OrchestrationGenerationResult(groundedPlan, GenerationRouteMode.LearnedFlowGrounding,
>             BoundarySource.Classifier, RetrievalSource.None,
>             MlGenerated: true, contract.Kind, warnings));
> }
>
> // Step 5: Mode 2 — KNN + PatternMap, respects PhaseScope constraint; MlGenerated=true.
> // Also handles KnownFlowPlanning when _flowGroundingKnn is empty (untrained machine).
> var nearest = _knn.FindNearest(prompt);
> var planText = ApplyPatternMapOverlay(nearest, _patternMap, prompt, contract.PhaseScope);
> return OperationResult<OrchestrationGenerationResult>.Ok(
>     new OrchestrationGenerationResult(planText, GenerationRouteMode.Mode2Generalization,
>         BoundarySource.Classifier, RetrievalSource.None, MlGenerated: true, contract.Kind, warnings));
> ```
>
> ### GetOrchestratorAsync → OperationResult\<ILogicalOrchestrator\>
>
> ```csharp
> var trainedComposer = new TrainedRouteComposerUnit(this);         // three-mode dispatcher
> var pipeline = new TaskOrchestrationUnit(routeComposer: trainedComposer);
> var orchestrator = new OrchestrationPlanOrchestrator(pipeline);   // : ILogicalOrchestrator
> return OperationResult<ILogicalOrchestrator>.Ok(orchestrator);
> ```
>
> ### Constructor (loads FlowIndex from corpus dir; PromptFlowIndex removed)
>
> ```csharp
> public OrchestrationPlanMachine()
> {
>     // No corpus dir loading. All ML state starts empty.
>     // Training fills _flowGroundingKnn, _patternMap, etc. via TrainOrchestrationBatchAsync.
>     // Restore from checkpoint via LoadCheckpointAsync. No FlowIndex. No PromptFlowIndex.
> }
> ```
> Note: `privateCorpusDir` constructor parameter is REMOVED in v19. Canonical FLOW docs are consumed by
> the corpus builder (OrchestrationCorpusBuilder) to produce Mode 1 training pairs, not by the machine constructor.
> OrchestrationCorpusAudit.LoadFlowDocs(sourceDir) is called from corpus builder only, not from machine.
>
> ### SaveCheckpointAsync / LoadCheckpointAsync
>
> **What is saved (all six sections — ALL trained ML state):**
> 1. `_flowGroundingKnn` (Mode 1 LearnedFlowGrounding KNN store)
> 2. `_flowGroundingWeights` (Mode 1 FLOW-specific pattern weights)
> 3. `_patternMap` (Mode 2 generalization weights)
> 4. `_knn` (Mode 2 KNN store)
> 5. `_humanExplanationPatternMap` (Mode 3 weights; omitted section if empty)
> 6. `_humanExplanationKnn` (Mode 3 KNN store; omitted section if empty)
>
> **NOT in checkpoint:** FlowIndex is NOT embedded — it never existed as a runtime component. `_flowIndex` field was removed entirely in v19. No section 7. Canonical FLOW docs are training data only (input to corpus builder), not a checkpoint artifact.
>
> **Constructor behavior:**
> - `new OrchestrationPlanMachine()` (no corpus dir): all KNN/patternMap state starts empty.
> - `LoadCheckpointAsync(path)`: restores all six ML state sections; `privateCorpusDir` not required at all.
> - Fresh process + `LoadCheckpointAsync`: fully functional for marketplace import/inference/continue-training.
>
> **Checkpoint report section** (written on `LoadCheckpointAsync`):
> ```json
> {
>   "trainedStateLoaded": true,
>   "mode1FlowGroundingKnnSize": N,
>   "mode1FlowGroundingWeightsSize": N,
>   "mode2KnnStoreSize": N,
>   "mode2PatternMapSize": N,
>   "mode3KnnStoreSize": N,
>   "mode3HumanExplanationPatternMapSize": N,
>   "mode1TrainedPairsRestored": N,
>   "mode2TrainedPairsRestored": N,
>   "mode3TrainedPairsRestored": N
> }
> ```
> `mode1FlowGroundingKnnSize > 0` and `mode2KnnStoreSize > 0` are required assertions in Gate B B.6 and B.7.
>

>
> ## Step 3 — TrainedRouteComposerUnit + OrchestrationPlanOrchestrator
>
> **TrainedRouteComposerUnit : IRouteComposerUnit**
> - `ExecuteAsync(request)` → calls `_machine.GeneratePlanAsync(request.Input.Request.UserPrompt)`
>   (full raw user prompt, not `Intent.Goal` which may be normalized/truncated) → unwraps `OrchestrationGenerationResult`; three-mode dispatch
> - `HasEnoughStructure`:
>   - `true` when plan text contains ≥ 2 phase labels OR ≥ 1 gate label (retrieval or trained output)
>   - `false` when output is empty or resembles Bootstrap template header only
>   (this prevents `OrchestrationVerifier` from accepting structureless plans)
> - `Warnings: []` normally; `["retrieval_miss_fallback_to_mode2"]` when FLOW ref detected but
>   FlowIndex lookup returned null
>
> **OrchestrationPlanOrchestrator : ILogicalOrchestrator**
> - `FlowId = "orchestration-plan-orchestrator"`
> - Follows `ProjectLocalWikiOrchestrator` pattern
> - `RunAsync(request, ct)` → extracts UserPrompt + ActiveProjectRoot from Metadata → calls `_pipeline.OrchestrateAsync(...)` → maps to `LogicalOrchestratorResult`
>

>
> ## Step 4 — OrchestrationPilotLoopRunner (OrchestrationPilotLoopRunner.cs)
>
> Mirrors TatoebaPilotLoopRunner:
>
> ```csharp
> public sealed record OrchestrationPilotLoopRunOptions(
>     string PrivatePairsPath,
>     // PrivateCorpusDir: REMOVED in v19. Machine constructor takes no corpus dir.
>     // FLOW docs consumed by corpus builder only. Runner needs only PrivatePairsPath.
>     int TrainSetSize = 50,                   // Mode 2 pairs per cycle (documentation-learning discipline)
>     int TestSetSize = 50,                    // Mode 2 held-out eval pairs per cycle
>     int Mode3TrainSetSize = 20,              // Mode 3 pairs per cycle (independent from Mode 2 batch)
>     int MaxCycles = 29,
>     double FlowGroundingTarget = 0.75,       // learnedFlowGroundingAccuracy gate (Mode 1 ML accuracy)
>     double StyleTarget = 0.75,               // unseenStyleAccuracy gate (Mode 2 ML accuracy)
>     double ExplanationTarget = 0.70,         // humanExplanationAccuracy gate (Mode 3 ML accuracy)
>     string? CheckpointPath = null,
>     bool RequireCheckpointResume = false,
>     OrchestrationCheckpointCache? Cache = null);
> ```
>
> - Cache-first → disk → fresh/fail startup (FIX-1 pattern from TranslationMachine)
> - **On resume**: load checkpoint → checkpoint load restores ALL trained ML state directly
>   (`_patternMap`, `_knn`, `_humanExplanationKnn`, `_humanExplanationPatternMap`); restore cursor +
>   LastCompletedCycle + TrainedPairIds from checkpoint fields.
>   **⚠ DO NOT call `TrainOrchestrationBatchAsync` or `TrainBatchAsync` on restored TrainedPairIds.**
>   TrainedPairIds are used ONLY for: (a) candidate exclusion (skip already-trained pairs in new cycles),
>   (b) selection reporting (how many Mode 2 / Mode 3 pairs were previously trained), (c) row count metrics.
>   Re-training on restored pairs = double-training of already-learned weights (replay bug class).
>   Report fields: `initialTrainingSkippedDueCheckpoint=true`, `resumeTrainBatchCalls=0`,
>   `trainedPairIdsUsedForExclusionOnly=true`, `trainedPairIdsRestoredCount=N`,
>   `mode2TrainedPairsRestored=N`, `mode3TrainedPairsRestored=N`.
> - **Each cycle — single combined TrainOrchestrationBatchAsync call (MANDATORY)**:
>   Mode 2 and Mode 3 pairs for a cycle MUST be combined into ONE `OrchestrationTrainingBatch` and passed to
>   ONE `TrainOrchestrationBatchAsync` call. Separate calls per mode are FORBIDDEN — they create an intermediate
>   state where Mode 2 is trained but Mode 3 is not yet, with no checkpoint in between (replay crash window).
>   The `OrchestrationTrainingBatch` carries mode-tagged pairs; `TrainOrchestrationBatchAsync` routes internally
>   by `pair.Mode`. Implementation steps per cycle:
>   1. Select `TrainSetSize` Mode 2 pairs NOT in `TrainedPairIds`.
>   2. Select up to `Mode3TrainSetSize` Mode 3 pairs NOT in `TrainedPairIds`.
>   3. Combine all selected pairs into ONE `OrchestrationTrainingBatch`.
>   4. Call `TrainOrchestrationBatchAsync` ONCE with the combined batch.
>   5. **Immediately add ALL PairIds** from the combined batch to `TrainedPairIds`.
>   6. **Immediately save checkpoint** (TrainedPairIds + all ML state). One checkpoint save per cycle closes
>      the crash window for both Mode 2 and Mode 3 in a single atomic operation.
>   7. Evaluate: Mode 2 on `TestSetSize` held-out pairs; Mode 3 on `Mode3HeldOutEvalPairs`.
>   8. Check Mode 2 promotion: `newStructuralTokenRate > 0.25` AND `seenFlowRate < 0.75` → add to `Mode2PromotedPairIds`.
>   9. Check Mode 3 promotion: `humanExplanationAccuracy >= ExplanationTarget` → add to `Mode3PromotedPairIds`.
>   Promotion decisions are independent. `TrainedPairIds.Count > 0` after the first cycle is a hard invariant.
>   ORCH_ACCURACY_SET prints `mode3_train_rows=N` per cycle.
> - Save checkpoint additionally at end of full run (final state).
>
> **OnCycleCompleted**:
> ```
> ORCH_ACCURACY_SET cycle=N mode2_train_rows=N mode3_train_rows=N mode2_test_rows=N mode3_test_rows=N
>   routeMode=LearnedFlowGrounding|Mode2Generalization|Mode3HumanExplanation|Passthrough [per-pair detail]
>   boundarySource=Classifier                                                            [always Classifier]
>   mlGenerated=true|false                                                               [true for Modes 1/2/3; false for Passthrough]
>   intentKind=KnownFlowPlanning|PhaseContinuation|...                                  [per-pair detail]
>   checkpoint_saved=true                                                                [every cycle]
>   --- mode accuracy (all ML metrics) ---
>   learnedFlowGroundingAccuracy=0.NNN     [Mode 1 ML accuracy on held-out pairs]
>   unseenStyleAccuracy=0.NNN              [Mode 2 ML accuracy]
>   overallTrainingAccuracy=0.NNN          [= mean(learnedFlowGrounding, unseenStyle)]
>   exactPromptHitRate=0.NNN              [hard gate: must = 0.000 for Mode 2+3 eval]
>   humanExplanationAccuracy=0.NNN|SKIPPED_NO_MODE3_PAIRS
>   phaseCountAccuracy=0.NNN artifactRecall=0.NNN gateSequenceAccuracy=0.NNN
>   stackRefAccuracy=0.NNN taskTypeRecall=0.NNN|SKIPPED
>   --- compliance hard gates (must reach target before passesGate) ---
>   forbiddenScopeViolationRate=0.NNN      [hard gate: must = 0.000]
>   phaseOnlyCompliance=0.NNN             [hard gate: must = 1.000]
>   approvalGateCompliance=0.NNN          [hard gate: must = 1.000]
>   --- soft compliance ---
>   humanIntentAccuracy=0.NNN scopeBoundaryAccuracy=0.NNN artifactNoiseResistance=0.NNN
>   --- promotion ---
>   newStructuralTokenRate=0.NNN seenFlowRate=0.NNN
>   promotedToTraining=true|false promotionDecision=PROMOTE|HOLD
>   trainedStateLoaded=true|false
> ```
>

> ## Step 5 — CLI commands (27.TranslationDomain.Tools/Program.cs)
>
> ```
> audit-orchestration-corpus
>   --source-dir <absolute path>
>   --output <audit.json absolute path>
>
> build-orchestration-corpus
>   --source-dir <absolute path>
>   --audit <audit.json absolute path>
>   --output <corpus.jsonl absolute path>
>   [--pairs-per-flow 8]
>
> run-orchestration-loop
>   --private-pairs <corpus.jsonl absolute path>

>

>   --private-pairs <corpus.jsonl absolute path>
>   --linked-model <model_id>                      # e.g. "orchestration-v1"
>   --output <training-data/orchestration/v1/ directory>

>   #           corpus-pointer.json (sha256 + schema_version; NO absolute private path committed)

> import-orchestration-model
>   --manifest <models/orchestration/v1/manifest.json>

>   # Loads from manifest.checkpoint_filename; no corpus dir required

> publish-orchestration-model
>   --manifest <models/orchestration/v1/manifest.json>
>   # Registers model in models/index.json (file-backed marketplace registry)
>   # Creates or updates entry: model_id → manifest path + accuracy + version

> load-orchestration-model
>   --model-id <orchestration-v1>
>   # Resolves via models/index.json → loads manifest → imports model
>   # Output: loaded machine ready for GeneratePlanAsync
>
> continue-orchestration-training
>   --manifest <models/orchestration/v1/manifest.json>
>   --training-manifest <training-data/orchestration/v1/training-manifest.json>
>   --private-pairs <corpus.jsonl absolute path>   # resolved by corpus-pointer.json sha256 verification
>   [--max-cycles 1]
>   [--dry-run]                       # verify setup only; no actual training
>   # Verifies corpus_sha256 matches; loads model from manifest; excludes TrainedPairIds; trains

> ## Step 6 — Tests (41 total, Tests/OrchestrationPlanTests.cs)
>
> | # | Name | Assertion |
> |---|------|-----------|
> | 1 | `OrchestrationCorpusAudit_DetectsFormatA` | FLOW-01 → format=A, TrainingReady=true, all 4 fields non-empty |
> | 2 | `OrchestrationCorpusAudit_DetectsFormatB` | FLOW-04 → format=B, extracts from ЗАЧЕМ/В КАКОМ ПОРЯДКЕ |
